title: Student Success & Community Manager (Full-Time Remote)
description:
Student Success & Community Manager

Full-Time Remote Position

About Us



Get Rich Detailing is a rapidly growing marketing and business education company that helps automotive detailing businesses generate more leads, more bookings, and more revenue through advertising, marketing systems, AI automation, and business coaching.



We currently support over 105 active students across the United States and continue to grow every month.



Our students rely on us for guidance, support, advertising services, and business growth strategies. Because of this, delivering an exceptional student experience is one of the most important parts of our company.



We are looking for a highly organized, professional, and reliable Student Success & Community Manager to take ownership of student communication inside our Skool (SKOOL) community and help ensure every student receives timely support and attention.



Position Overview



Your primary responsibility will be managing communication inside our Skool community.



On a typical day, you can expect to communicate with approximately 20+ students regarding questions, requests, updates, and support needs.



You will not be responsible for running advertising campaigns, managing ad accounts, or making marketing decisions.



Instead, your role is to:



Communicate with students

Answer common questions

Gather information

Submit student requests

Escalate issues when necessary

Keep conversations organized

Ensure every student feels supported



Think of yourself as the bridge between our students and our internal team.



Primary Responsibilities

Student Communication



You will communicate with students daily inside our Skool community.



Students may reach out regarding:



Advertising questions

Campaign updates

Meta ad account issues

Cost Per Lead (CPL) concerns

Ad creative requests

New ad launch requests

Call requests with management

Tier upgrades

Hiring ad requests

Program questions

Technical issues

General support requests



The most important responsibility in this role is ensuring students receive fast, professional, and helpful responses.



Students should never feel ignored or forgotten.



Response Time Expectations



Students must be checked on and responded to consistently throughout the day.



Minimum expectations include:



Monitoring Skool multiple times daily

Responding to student messages promptly

Following up on conversations when needed

Ensuring students receive updates on outstanding requests

Maintaining a professional and positive experience



Students should generally receive attention 2–3 times per day when active conversations are taking place.



Student Request Management



A major part of this role involves determining when a student request should be submitted.



Student Requests are internal forms used to notify management when a student needs assistance with something that requires backend access or action.



Examples of Student Requests



Submit a Student Request when:



A student wants new ads launched

A student wants ad creative changes

A student wants campaign adjustments

A student wants to lower their CPL

A student reports advertising issues

A student requests technical assistance

A student wants paint correction ads launched

A student wants ceramic coating ads launched

A student requests a call with management

A student needs backend account changes



Every conversation that requires action from management should have a Student Request submitted.



Accuracy and organization are extremely important.



Common Situations You'll Handle

Example #1: Ad Error



Student:

"My ads show an error."



Your responsibility:



Reassure the student

Let them know we will investigate

Gather any necessary information

Submit a Student Request

Example #2: Meta Sca
ssages



Student:

"I received a message saying
 is shutting down my account."



Your responsibility:



Explain that these messages are common scams

Reassure the student

Let them know they can ignore the message



No Student Request required.



Example #3: High Cost Per Lead (CPL)



Student:

"My CPL is too high."



Your responsibility:



Acknowledge the concern

Let them know management will review it

Submit a Student Request



You are not responsible for optimizing campaigns.



Tier Verification Responsibilities



Certain services require students to be enrolled in our Tier 2 program.



Examples include:



Paint Correction Advertising

Ceramic Coating Advertising



If a student requests these services:



If Student Is Tier 2

Submit Student Request

If Student Is Not Tier 2

Direct them to contact the appropriate tea
mber about upgrading

Once upgraded, submit Student Request

Hiring Ad Requests



Students occasionally request hiring advertisements.



When this occurs:



Explain that hiring ads require an additional fee

Direct the student to the appropriate tea
mber to process payment

Once approved, follow internal procedures

Training & Support



You will receive complete training covering:



Student communication

Community management

Student Request procedures

Escalation processes

Company policies

Common student questions

Tier structures

Internal systems



You will also have direct access to management whenever you are unsure how to handle a situation.



We prefer questions over assumptions.



Qualifications

Required

Excellent written English

Strong communication skills

Reliable internet connection

Professional attitude

Strong organizational skills

Detail-oriented

Ability to follow systems and processes

Ability to multitask and manage conversations

Preferred (Not Required)

Customer support experience

Virtual assistant experience

Community management experience

 (Meta) Ads familiarity

Marketing agency experience

GoHighLevel experience

CRM software experience

Social media marketing knowledge



You do not need to know how to run advertisements.



A basic understanding of marketing terminology is helpful, but we will provide training on our systems and processes.



Who Will Succeed In This Role?



The ideal candidate is:



Friendly

Professional

Organized

Responsive

Consistent

Proactive

Comfortable communicating with people throughout the day

Able to follow instructions carefully

Willing to learn and improve



If you enjoy helping people, staying organized, and being part of a growing company where your work directly impacts customer satisfaction, we'd love to hear from you.

title: AI Video + VFX + Real Scene Producer Needed for Premium Brand Videos
description:
Comment to "Type of Employment: Any": This starts as two Gigs, but can turn into a long Full-Time job.



Now to the 

JOB DESCRIPTION:



Project: two Videos (Short Clips)

One will need AI and VFX skills. The other is some real-life filming and IA skills.



We are looking for a highly capable video creator or a small production team for two separate CruiseLife brand videos.

These are not simple Canva videos, not slideshow videos, and not stock-footage-only projects. We need someone who can realistically judge what is possible with AI video, VFX, animation, stock material, and real filming — and then produce a professional final result.

You may apply for Video 1 only, Video 2 only, or both videos, but please be very clear about what you can actually deliver.

________________________________________

Project 1: “The CruiseLife WAVE”

This video requires a cinematic beach scene where a wave transforms into the CruiseLife wordmark.

The key visual idea:

A bright, sunny, elegant beach scene. A wave rolls toward the viewer. The water gradually forms abstract shapes, then hints of upside-down letters, then rotates into upright letters, and finally, the word CruiseLife lands deeply in the wet sand as a large 3D wordmark.

This project requires:

• Strong VFX / animation capability 

• Water simulation or convincing AI/VFX water effects 

• 3D text/wordmark integration 

• Realistic interaction between wave, sand, splash, droplets, and letters 

• Ability to follow a detailed storyboard 

• Ability to avoid side-view mistakes, mirrored letters, or generic wave footage 

• Final output suitable for brand marketing 

Important:

This project previously failed because the freelancer could edit video but could not deliver the required VFX. Please do not apply for this project unless you can show real examples of comparable VFX, water effects, 3D text integration, or advanced AI/VFX work.

________________________________________

Project 2: CruiseLife USP Video

This is a brand / USP video explaining the emotional and commercial idea behind CruiseLife.

The video will probably combine:

• AI-generated scenes 

• Stock footage where suitable 

• Motion graphics 

• Text overlays 

• Voice-over and music 

• Possibly a few scenes with real people 

Important:

This project previously failed because the available AI/stock material was not enough. Some scenes may require real human performance, lifestyle shots, or staged scenes with people.

Therefore, we need someone who can either:

1. Personally film simple scenes with real people,

or 

2. Organize/direct such filming,

or 

3. Clearly explain which scenes can be created with AI and which scenes must be filmed. 

Please do not apply if your only method is downloading stock clips and putting text on top.

________________________________________

What We Need From You

Please apply only if you can provide:

• A realistic production plan 

• Honest assessment of what can be done with AI, VFX, stock footage, and real filming 

• Strong English communication 

• Ability to work from a detailed storyboard/script 

• Regular progress updates 

• Short preview clips before final rendering 

• Clean final export in high quality 

• Commercial usage rights for all footage, music, voice, AI output, and edited material 

________________________________________

Required Application Details

Please answer these questions in your application:

1. Are you applying for Video 1, Video 2, or both? 

2. Which tools do you use? Example: Runway, Kling, Veo, Midjourney, After Effects, Blender, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, etc. 

3. For Video 1: Can you create realistic VFX involving waves, water, sand, splash, and 3D text? Please show examples. 

4. For Video 2: Can you film or organize simple scenes with real people if AI/stock footage is not enough? 

5. Please send 3–5 examples of your best relevant work. 

6. What exactly did you personally do in those examples? 

7. Are you comfortable working from a very detailed storyboard and following exact visual instructions? 

8. What would be your recommended workflow for this type of project? 

9. What is your estimated price range for a 30–60 second video of this quality? 

10. How many revisions are included? 

________________________________________

Important Quality Requirement

We are not looking for someone who simply says, “Yes, I can do it.”

We are looking for someone who can say:

• “This part is possible with AI.” 

• “This part needs VFX.” 

• “This part should be filmed.” 

• “This part is risky.” 

• “This is the best workflow.” 

• “Here is a small test before we continue.” 

Honesty and technical judgment are more important than overpromising.

________________________________________

First Step / Test

Before awarding the full project, we may request a short paid test scene.

For Video 1, this could be a 5–10 second sample showing wave / water / 3D wordmark integration.

For Video 2, this could be a 10–15 second sample scene showing the intended style, pacing, stock/AI/filmed material approach, and overall brand feeling.

________________________________________

Brand Context

CruiseLife is a lifestyle and fashion brand. The tone should be:

• Positive 

• Sunny 

• Elegant 

• Emotional 

• Aspirational 

• Premium but not arrogant 

• Suitable for international marketing 

The goal is to create video content that feels like a real brand campaign, not like a cheap AI experiment.

________________________________________

Please Do Not Apply If

• You only create basic AI videos without editing skill 

• You only use stock footage 

• You cannot do or coordinate VFX 

• You cannot follow a detailed storyboard 

• You cannot communicate clearly in English 

• You cannot show relevant examples 

• You are not comfortable doing a small test first 

________________________________________

Final Deliverables

Final deliverables should include:

title: HIRING: AI-POWERED VIDEO & STATIC AD EDITOR | FULL-TIME | Health/Beauty DTC Brand
description:
READ THIS FULLY BEFORE APPLYING.



We are a fast-growing health and beauty e-commerce brand running paid ads aggressively on
 and Instagram across Australia, Canada, the UK, New Zealand, and Ireland. We are looking for ONE dedicated, full-time editor to join our team long-term. This is not a general editing job. If you cannot use AI tools to create content from scratch, please do not apply.



WHO WE ARE



We are a direct-to-consumer health and beauty brand scaling hard across five English-speaking markets. We produce a high volume of direct response video ads and static creatives every week, and we need someone who can execute at a high level while thinking creatively to help us grow.



THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF:



- You have never created direct response ads

- You do not have real, hands-on experience with Higgsfield. This is non-negotiable.

- You cannot use AI tools to generate footage, avatars, images, or scenes

- You only do cinematic, wedding, or YouTube-style editing

- You cannot commit to 40 hours per week

- Your English is not strong. Clear written communication is required daily.

- You cannot source your own content from AI tools, stock, TikTok, UGC, or other sources

- You cannot meet deadlines consistently



WHAT YOU WILL DO



1. Direct response video ads (30 seconds to 5 minutes)



We write the scripts. You turn them into finished ads. You will:



- Use Higgsfield as your primary AI generation tool for footage, scenes, and product visuals

- Supplement with tools like Runway, Sora, Kling, HeyGen, NanoBanana, or Midjourney where needed

- Source additional footage from stock libraries, YouTube, TikTok, Canva, and UGC creators

- Blend all sources into one clean, cohesive, high-converting ad

- Nail the hook in the first 3 seconds. Every single time.

- Use direct response pacing: fast and punchy, not slow or cinematic

- Add captions, music, and SFX where they help. Nothing more.

- Deliver in 9:16, 1:1, and 4:5 formats



2. Static Meta ad creatives



The copy is written by our team. Your job is to bring it to life visually. You will produce:



- Problem-to-solution images

- Benefit-driven visuals

- Testimonial-style creatives

- Us vs. Them comparison images

- Clean, high-converting designs



AI IS A CORE PART OF THIS JOB. YOU MUST ALREADY KNOW HOW TO:



- Work fluently inside Higgsfield. This is your primary tool and experience with it is required.

- Create talking-head or avatar videos using tools like HeyGen

- Generate B-roll, scenes, and product visuals using AI tools

- Write precise prompts to get the output you need

- Combine AI footage with sourced footage into a polished, finished ad



We will test this. "Familiar with AI tools" is not enough.



TOOLS YOU SHOULD KNOW:



- Higgsfield (required)

- CapCut, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or After Effects

- Runway, Sora, Kling, HeyGen, or similar AI video tools

- NanoBanana, Midjourney, Pika, or similar AI image tools

- Canva

- Google Drive



All paid tools will be provided by us.



EXPECTED WEEKLY OUTPUT:



- 3 to 6 video ads per week

- 5 to 10 static ads per week

- Hook variations and iterations as needed



Output increases as you get familiar with the brand.



WHAT WE OFFER:



- $800 USD per month to start, with real earning potential as you grow with us

- Full-time, 40 hours per week

- Payment via Wise

- All paid software provided

- Scripts and creative direction provided

- Clear, fast feedback

- A long-term role where strong performance is recognized and rewarded

- A small, focused team where your work directly drives results



WHAT WE DON'T CARE ABOUT:



We are not looking at degrees, certificates, or job titles. We don't care where you studied or what your resume looks like on paper. We care about how you think, how you solve problems, and what you can actually produce. If your work is sharp and your mind is sharper, that matters more to us than anything else.



HOW TO APPLY:



1. Start your application with the word COUNTDOWN. Applications without it will not be opened.

2. List every AI tool you have personally used and exactly what you made with each. Be specific. "Used HeyGen to create avatar ads for a skincare brand" not "familiar with AI." Tell us specifically how you have used Higgsfield.

3. Walk us through how you would take a 60-second script and turn it into a finished ad. Where do you use AI? Where do you source footage? How do you handle captions?

4. Send us your best work. Include at least 3 direct response video ads, 5 static creatives, and the names of brands you have worked with. Show us what you are actually capable of.



ONE LAST THING:



We are moving fast. We intend to hire within 72 hours of posting this. If you know this is you, do not sit on it. Apply now.



Reply directly to this post or
 us at: 



Incomplete applications will not be considered. If you read this far and you know you can deliver, we want to hear from you.

We are a Chicago-based real estate investment and property management company. We are looking for a dedicated, long-term, full-time Executive Assistant to become the operational backbone of our company and handle a wide variety of administrative tasks.



IMPORTANT: We are looking for a direct hire. NO AGENCIES. We want someone who is looking for a stable, single-client home.



What You Will Do (The Day-to-Day):

This is a dynamic role. Some days you will be heavily focused on data, and other days you will be doing general administrative research or organizing files. Your responsibilities will include:



General Administration & Ad-Hoc Projects (The Bulk of Your Time): Managing the executive inbox, organizing Google Drive folders, researching new software/tools, creating and updating Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and general data entry.



Financial Accuracy: Handling receipts, invoices, and expense tracking. You must be able to cross-reference actual receipts against spreadsheets with 100?curacy. Accuracy is more important to us than speed.



Short-Term Rental Management (1-2 Hours/Week): Managing guest communications via Hospitable, handling Airbnb claims, and coordinating seamlessly with our local cleaning crews (Turno) and handymen in Chicago.



CRM Management & Lead Gen (1-2 Hours/Day): Maintaining our Podio database, running property data (like geocoding or zoning), and ensuring our workflows stay organized. There is also potential for Inside Sales (ISA) work, such as calling leads or coordinating with answering services.



Requirements (Non-Negotiable):



Hours: You must work full-time during US Central Standard Time (CST) business hours. This means working the graveyard shift in the Philippines.



Time Tracking: All hours must be logged in real time using our time tracking software. This is non-negotiable and is verified daily.



Single-Client Commitment: This is a full-time, exclusive role. We are aware that billing multiple clients simultaneously happens in the VA community. We do not permit it and we verify compliance. If this is your practice, please do not apply.



Infrastructure: You must have a primary high-speed internet connection AND a reliable backup internet source (mobile hotspot/pocket WiFi). You must also have backup power (UPS or generator) to work through brownouts/typhoons.



Tech Comfort: You don't need to be a developer, but you must be comfortable learning new platforms quickly (Podio, Google Workspace, Hospitable, Zapier).



Communication: Flawless written English and a comfortable, professional phone voice for calling US-based vendors.



The "Bias for Action": If a guest reports a stain or a document is missing, you don't just report the problem to the owner—you initiate the solution, order the replacement, and present the completed task.



How to Apply:

We receive dozens of applications, and we only hire people who read the details.



Please apply via
/platfor
ssage.



To prove you have read this entire job post, you must change the subject line of your application to: "Chicago RE Admin - [Insert Your Favorite Color]". If your subject line says anything else, your application will be deleted.



In your message, include a brief summary of your administrative experience and describe a time you had to find an answer yourself without asking your manager. What was the situation and how did you find it?

Note: Finalists will be required to complete a brief skills assessment via TestGorilla to verify data entry and reasoning skills.



Compensation & Performance Bonuses:

-Strong Base Pay: $1,000 USD per month, paid bi-weekly via Wise or PayPal.

-Monthly Operational Bonuses: Up to $200/month in extra pay tied directly to flawless execution. You earn this by maintaining 100% accuracy in tasks including Asana task execution, and keeping our Airbnb guest ratings at 4.9+ stars.

-Acquisition Bonuses ($500 per closed deal): > This is NOT a bonus for doing standard CRM data entry on existing leads. To earn this bonus, you must be the originator of the warm lead. This means you either:

title: Daily Accountability Caller — Personal Check-In Support
description:
--What this role is--

I have ADHD and benefit from real human accountability at key transition points in my day. Text reminders don't work for me, but a live phone call does.



I need someone to make 3 short scheduled phone calls to me each day — a wake-up call, an afternoon transition call, and an evening wind-down call. Calls are typically 2–10 minutes.



This is not an assistant or admin role. You are not managing my calendar or solving problems for me. Your job is to call at the scheduled time, ask a few simple questions, and stay on the line until I've made a decision or started the next thing. Reliability and punctuality are the whole job.



--Schedule--

Wake-up — 9:30 PM Manila / 6:30 AM Pacific, Monday–Friday

Afternoon — 7:00–7:30 AM Manila / 4:00–4:30 PM Pacific, Monday–Friday

Evening — 1:00 PM Manila / 10:00 PM Pacific, every day including weekends



--What each call looks like--

Wake-up (Mon–Fri): Call me at 6:30am my time. If I don't answer, wait 2 minutes and call again. The goal is not just waking me up — it's making sure I am physically out of bed and starting my morning before we hang up.



Afternoon (Mon–Fri): Help me transition from work to family time. Ask: What's the dinner plan tonight? Have you checked in with your partner about the evening? What needs to happen before bedtime? If I say I'm in the middle of something, ask me when a good stopping point is and call back in 5–10 minutes.



Evening (daily): Ask what still needs to happen tonight, whether I've prepared for tomorrow, and what time I'm planning to be asleep. Stay on the line until I've actually started winding down.



--What makes someone right for this--

Punctual and consistent — this matters more than anything else

Warm and natural on the phone in English

Comfortable staying on the line in silence while I finish writing something or wrap up a task

Not trying to give advice or coach me — just ask the questions and be present

Call center or BPO background is a strong plus



--Pay and terms--

$125/month flat rate, paid on the 1st of each month via Wise. Month-to-month. No fixed contract — I want someone who stays because the arrangement works for both of us.



I may occasionally adjust or skip a call with advance notice — I'll always let you know by the night before at the latest.

Logging, monitoring, and on-call response habits

PostgreSQL working knowledge

Uses AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) to ship faster

Real production migration experience between platforms

Go (or willingness to learn)

Portainer or Kubernetes

SaaS or multi-tenant background



How to Apply

1. Your full name and location

2. Years of back-end development experience

3. Your top 3-5 strongest tools or platforms (be specific — Cloudflare Workers, Docker, AWS Lambda, PostgreSQL, etc.)

Applications missing the final two answers will not be reviewed.

title: Venue Analytics SaaS Platform Development
description:
About the Product



We are building a venue analytics SaaS platform for venue managers. It allows managers to upload floor performance data and receive formatted analytics reports. The product has a highly specific visual identity built around a dark theme, serif/monospace typography pairing, and a precise colour and data hierarchy system.



What You'll Be Building



This is a focused, design-led data product. The core work involves:



Building and refining a multi-tab React dashboard with a custom design system (no off-the-shelf UI kits)

File upload and data ingestion pipelines

Backend APIs in Python/FastAPI with PostgreSQL for data storage and processing

Report generation and formatting output for venue managers

Auth flows, user settings, and account management



What We're Looking For



Frontend craft is the priority. You should be able to look at a detailed design spec and implement it with precision, including pixel-accurate layouts, custom typography, and a data visualisation layer that actually looks considered. Functional but ugly is not good enough for this product.



Backend competence is required but does not need to be your primary strength. You should be comfortable with APIs, data modelling, and file processing without needing to be a systems engineer.

Required



React (strong, with evidence of polished dashboard or data product work)

TypeScript

Python / FastAPI

PostgreSQL

Custom CSS / Tailwind with the ability to deviate from defaults intentionally

Git / GitHub



Helpful



Experience with file upload and parsing pipelines (CSV, Excel)

Chart or data visualisation libraries (Recharts, D3, or similar)

Report generation (PDF output)

Stripe billing

Render or similar hosting



Who This Suits



A developer who takes visual quality seriously alongside technical correctness. You should be able to show at least one dashboard or data product you have built that you are genuinely proud of aesthetically, not just one that worked.

Working Arrangement



Remote, Philippines-based preferred

Full-time

Must overlap some hours with Australia/AEST

Long-term engagement

Please include your expected monthly or hourly rate



How to Apply

Send through your CV or profile, GitHub or code examples, and at least one example of a dashboard or data-heavy frontend you have built. A short note on which parts of this role you are strongest in is appreciated.

title: Guest Experience Virtual Assistant, Sierra Sol Elevated Stays
description:
Sierra Sol Elevated Stays is a locally rooted, family-owned property management company serving Northern New Mexico (Santa Fe, Taos, Angel Fire, and Red River) with over 150 properties. Our love for this region is what led us to build Sierra Sol Elevated Stays, focused on providing elevated stays for our guests and elevated stewardship for our homeowners. Our goal is to grow in a way that celebrates what makes New Mexico special – its people, culture, and enchanted lands – while delivering elevated experiences for guests and thoughtful, reliable stewardship for homeowners.



Tech stack (daily tools): Guesty (PMS + guest inbox), Breezeway (tasks/workorders + cleaning), RingCentral (calls/SMS).

Our Elevated Promises



Everything we do is guided by our Elevated Promises. They are our operating standard and the way we earn five-star stays and trusted, long-term homeowner partnerships.



1. Elevated Guest Engagement: Proactive, elevated hospitality from booking to five-star review. 

We believe vacations are special—something people save for, plan for, and look forward to. Our job is to make every stay feel seamless and memorable. We anticipate needs, communicate early, check in during the stay, and resolve issues quickly with warmth and care. Our guest journey is intentionally crafted to deliver the kind of responsiveness, thoughtfulness, and attention to detail that turns great trips into truly elevated experiences.



2. Elevated Home Stewardship: We care for every home as if it were our own.

As homeowners in these markets, we know what true home stewardship looks like. We operate with a proactive mindset of quality, consistency, and pride. Weekly home checks, rigorous cleaning standards, quality control, seasonal readiness, and preventive maintenance are all part of how we ensure every property is clean, protected, and presentation ready, for guests and for you. We treat every home with the same respect and diligence we expect for our own.



3. Elevated Homeowner Partnerships: We treat each home like our own investment.

Every homeowner has different goals – maximizing revenue, balancing personal use, focusing on long-term appreciation, or simply enjoying peace of mind. Our role is to be a true partner in those goals, not simply a property manager. As owners and operators in this region ourselves, our guidance comes from real-world results, not theory. Through regular business reviews, thoughtful design and amenity recommendations, revenue and pricing insights, and brand-building support, we help each property reach its highest potential.



Our Guest Experience team is one of the biggest ways we deliver these promises. This is hospitality work. You are a core part of our team, not an outsourced call-center function.



Job Description:

As a Guest Experience Virtual Assistant, you own guest communication and coordination. You are the voice of Sierra Sol, a core part of our team, and a key driver of five-star stays. You will manage guest messaging and calls, coordinate workorders and cleaning schedules with our local teams and vendors, and bring elevated hospitality and experiences to every stay.



You will own:

• Proactive outreach and warm guest engagement that drives five-star stays

• Guest messaging and phone communication

• Workorder coordination and task follow-through

• Cleaning scheduling and day-to-day coordination with our local team and vendors



Working Hours

We provide live coverage from 7:00am to 11:00pm Mountain Time (MDT). You will be assigned a consistent shift. On-call after hour coverage (11:00pm-7:00am MDT) is handled by a separate rotation.

Mountain Daylight Time (MDT) ? Philippines Time (PHT):

• 7am–3pm MDT ? 9pm–5am PHT

• 11am–7pm MDT ? 1am–9am PHT

• 3pm–11pm MDT ? 5am–1pm PHT

You will be assigned one shift. Overnight shifts include a differential.

On-call: 11pm–7am MDT is handled by an on-call rotation (separate from daily shift expectations).



Compensation and Incentives

• Base pay: $650-$750 USD per month (full-time, based on experience)

• Night shift (9p – 5a): +$50 per month

• Internet/tech allowance: $20 per month

• 13th month pay: offered in December (prorated for partial years)

• Monthly Bonus: Monthly 5-Star Bonus Pool (based on team review quality + individual SLA performance)

• PTO: Accrues at 1 paid days per month (usable after 90 days; no annual rollover)



Monthly 5-Star Bonus Pool

We keep the bonus simple, measurable, and tied directly to delivering elevated guest experiences — the heart of your role.

• Pool funding: $2.00 USD for every 5-star review received during the month.

• Quality gate: Pool funded only if the monthly average rating is 4.85+ and the review rate is 80%+.

• Distribution: The funded pool is divided equally among the Guest Experience Tea
mbers.

• Eligibility: You receive your share when monthly SLA and performance standards are met. Shares are not redistributed from non-eligible members.



Location

These roles are fully remote within the Philippines. However, we are building our core Guest Experience team in Cebu City, and applicants located in Cebu City or nearby areas are strongly preferred.

Concentrating our team locally helps us work more closely, support one another, and build the kind of connected, collaborative culture that lets us deliver truly elevated hospitality. It also allows for optional in-person training sessions, tea
etups, and shared learning opportunities.

Exceptional candidates from other regions will still be considered.



Role and Responsibilities:



Elevated Guest Engagement (Guesty + text/email)

• Answer guest messages (text,
, OTA inbox via Guesty) with warmth, clarity, and genuine care

• Proactively share helpful guidance (arrival, access, weather/roads, home-specific tips) and check in during the stay

• Keep conversations organized and ensure no guest is left waiting or confused

• Ensure every guest experience feels special and elevated



Welcome outreach (required for every reservation)

• Place a welcome phone call to every guest prior to arrival day and send a personalized welcome text

• Confirm access and comfort, offer help, and document any concerns quickly

• Identify opportunities to make the guest’s stay an elevated and memorable experience



Phone support (RingCentral)

• Answer calls quickly and calmly and return missed calls promptly

• Troubleshoot common issues (access, Wi-Fi, amenities, heating/hot tub basics) and escalate when needed



Workorders and coordination (Breezeway)

• Create workorders fast when issues arise and confirm vendor/team acknowledgment

• Track progress, follow up, and close the loop with guests and the local team

• Keep notes and task status clean so handoffs are seamless



Cleaning scheduling and turnovers (Breezeway)

• Coordinate turn cleaning schedules and special requests

• Ensure all turns are scheduled a minimum of one week prior to booking and confirm scheduled cleaner the day prior to a scheduled cleaning and communicate key notes to cleaners



Documentation and handoffs

• Maintain accurate property notes and updates

• Close out open items before shift end and hand off active issues with clear context



Monthly SLA Standards (required for bonus eligibility)

• Guest messages answered within 15 minutes during your shift (text,
, Guesty inbox)

• Phone calls answered within 30 seconds during your shift

• No open guest messages left at shift end; clean handoffs with clear notes

• Workorders created promptly and vendor/team acknowledgment confirmed quickly



Property Listing Management & OTA Updates

• Maintain accurate, up-to-date listings across Guesty, Airbnb, Vrbo, and other OTAs.

• Update photos, amenities, room configurations, access notes, and seasonal details as needed.

• Ensure descriptions reflect the true guest experience with clear, warm, and helpful language.

• Flag inconsistencies, outdated information, or missing details to the Manager for correction.

• Support seasonal updates (ski season, summer events, holiday periods) to elevate guest expectations and reduce pre-arrival questions.

• Ensure every listing reflects our Elevated Promises — clarity, care, and a welcoming tone.



Local expertise

• Become an expert on Santa Fe, Taos, Angel Fire, and Red River, including seasonal rhythms, weather and road impacts, and local norms.

• Learn the best restaurants, cafes, shops, activities, and experiences in each market so you can offer personalized, concierge-level recommendations that elevate each stay.

• Know our homes in detail: complete Matterport and photo walkthroughs; learn layouts, bedding, amenities, quirks, parking, access instructions, and any “good to know” details for guests.

• Stay current on local events and updates by checking event calendars, tourism sites, and community pages (including relevant local
 groups).

• Use your local and property knowledge proactively to help guests plan better stays, avoid common issues, and feel confidently looked after from booking to checkout.



What we look for

• Excellent written and spoken English and a warm, helpful tone

• Hospitality mindset (you enjoy caring for people, not just closing tickets)

• Strong ownership and follow-through, especially on weekends and busy days

• Detail-oriented and eager to learn homes, markets, and local context

• Comfortable learning and working inside Guesty, Breezeway, and RingCentral

• Reliable internet and a quiet, professional work environment



How to apply

Please submit the following:

• Resume/CV

• 2-minute voice recording introducing yourself and your experience (English)

• Speedtest.net result (screenshot)

• Short written samples: How would you respond to the following guest messages?

  - “The hot tub isn’t heating. Can you help?”

  - “Can we request a late checkout tomorrow?”

  - “We’re staying in Angel Fire — any recommendations for a great breakfast spot for our family?”

• Short written samples: These three guests message you at the same time. In what order would you respond and why?

  - “We can’t get into the home, the code isn’t working.”

  - “The Wi-Fi is slow and we need it for work.”

  - “Can we check out one hour later?”

Suggested
 subject line: "NM Guest Experience VA - [Your Name]"

title: QBO cleanup specialist
description:
## Job Title: QuickBooks Cleanup Specialist & Accountant (QBO Certified / BS or MS in Accounting)

### Job Overview

We are seeking a highly detail-oriented, remote **QuickBooks Online (QBO) Cleanup Specialist** based in the Philippines to rescue and reorganize our financial data.

Our books have a backlog starting from **January of this year**. We need an expert financial detective to jump in, reconcile multiple bank and credit card accounts, correct misclassifications, and optimize our Chart of Accounts. This is a temporary contract project with the potential to transition into a long-term, part-time or full-time bookkeeping role based on performance.

### Key Responsibilities

 * **Backlog & Catch-Up Bookkeeping:** Bring all financial data from January of this year up to the present day entirely up to date.

 * **Account Reconciliation:** Accurately reconcile multiple bank accounts and credit card statements against QuickBooks Online.

 * **Chart of Accounts Optimization:** Review, clean up, and restructure our current Chart of Accounts for better clarity and tax readiness.

 * **Data Categorization:** Audit past transactions to ensure all expenses, income, and transfers are properly and accurately categorized.

 * **Discrepancy Resolution:** Identify, investigate, and resolve any duplicate transactions, missing entries, or un-deposited funds.

### Required Qualifications & Skills

 * **Education:** Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting is **strictly required**. A **Master’s Degree in Accounting** is highly preferred.

 * **Certification:** Must be a **Certified QuickBooks Online ProAdvisor**.

 * **Experience:** Proven track record of successfully handling complex accounting cleanups and catching up on months of messy backlog data.

 * **Attention to Detail:** Exceptional analytical skills with the ability to spot errors and discrepancies quickly.

 * **Communication:** Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

 * **Work Environment:** Reliable high-speed internet connection with a backup power/internet solution (power outages will not disrupt your deadlines).

### Project Details & Compensation

 * **Hours:** Flexible, but requires a weekly sync during 8am - 4pm EST business hours.

 * **Compensation:** $700-$900/ mo depending on experience and qualifications.

### How to Apply

If you have the accounting expertise and the QBO skills to help us get back on track, please apply with the following:

 1. A link to your updated resume/CV.

 2. Proof of your QuickBooks Online Certification.

 3. A brief summary of a previous QuickBooks cleanup project you successfully completed.

 4. Please include the phrase **"QBO Detective Found"** at the very top of your cover letter so we know you read the entire posting.

title: Shopify Store Operator — AI-Driven Store (Systems-Minded, Full-Time)
description:
About us

We're a USA-based premium contemporary home décor brand — sculptural furniture, lighting, mirrors, and wall art. Our product pages read like a design gallery, not a discount store. We're looking for one sharp, detail-obsessed person to help us run and grow the store. You'll work US-friendly hours; we'll confirm the exact window.



What you'll do

• Operate our AI-driven store (the core). We run a custom dashboard, an AI agent system, and automation that does a lot of the work. Your job is to understand how it all fits together and run the machine — the right tool, the right step, in the right order.

• Run the AI listing pipeline. Our AI generates the product listings; you operate the workflow, push products live, and keep them flowing as new products arrive. You operate it — you don't write the copy.

• Quality-check for accuracy. Catch the factual errors that matter — wrong dimensions, wrong price, wrong product — before anything goes live.

• Own the store day to day. Handle whatever the Shopify store and storefront need; you're the go-to operator for "the store."

• Troubleshoot. When something looks off (wrong stock on the site, a product not showing, automation acting up), figure out where the problem is and drive the fix or flag it clearly.



This is NOT a copywriting job (the AI writes), NOT customer support, and NOT a basic listings job. It's a run-the-system role for someone who likes understanding how things work.



Who you are

• You're systems-minded and tech-comfortable. You enjoy learning how a complex setup works and can reason about how the pieces connect. You don't need to code — you need to "get" how things run and operate inside them. This is the most important thing.

• You use AI tools (ChatGPT / Claude) daily, know how to drive them to a good result, and can tell when the output is wrong.

• You're comfortable in Shopify (products, variants, collections, the draft-to-active flow).

• You're a troubleshooter — when something breaks, you trace it instead of guessing.

• You're adaptable — happy owning "the whole store," not just ticking off a fixed task list.

• You're meticulous about accuracy. A wrong dimension or price drives you crazy.

• Your written English is strong enough to communicate clearly. (You won't be writing product copy — the AI does that — so polished marketing writing is not required.)



What we offer

• Competitive pay with real raises as you grow.

• Full-time, long-term, stable work with one company (not juggling clients).

• 13th-month pay / year-end bonus plus performance bonuses.

• A founder who values good work and gives clear direction.



HOW TO APPLY (please read — applications that skip a step won't be reviewed)

1. Start your message with the word ATELIER so we know you actually read this post.

2. Tell us: in 2–3 sentences, describe a system, tool, or automated workflow you learned and operated — and how you used an AI tool (ChatGPT, Claude, etc.) in your work.

3. Quick reasoning question. Imagine a store set up like this: a dashboard pushes inventory to Shopify; an AI tool drafts the product listings; nothing goes live until a person approves it. A customer reports that a product shows the wrong stock number on the website. In a few sentences: how would you figure out where the problem is? (We're not looking for a "correct" answer — we want to see how you think through a system.)



We read every application that follows these three steps. We're excited to meet you.

title: Experienced Real Estate Caller - Lead Manager
description:
We are hiring a Lead Manager to nurture and manage our pipeline of real estate leads, ensuring no opportunities slip through the cracks. As a Lead Manager, you will be the main point of contact for warm leads: following up with prospects, building rapport, and guiding them until they are ready to close or speak with our acquisitions closer. Additionally, you will engage in targeted outbound prospecting, using our high-quality data (e.g. fresh county records for probate and foreclosures) to initiate conversations with potential sellers. This hybrid role is critical – you'll keep our funnel organized and full by both managing incoming leads and proactively hunting new ones. If you are a people-person who is also organized and driven, this could be a perfect fit.



Who We Are: The OmniKey Group is founded and led by top-ranking Fortune 500 Sales Managers with a proven track record of developing and employing elite talent. We don't just build businesses — we build careers. As we scale aggressively, we are looking for driven individuals who want to grow alongside a leadership team that knows how to invest in people.



Responsibilities:

Lead Nurturing: Manage a pipeline of ~50 active leads in our CRM. Promptly follow up with interested home sellers via phone, text, and
. Your goal is to build relationships over time – check in regularly, understand their situation, and keep our company top-of-mind for when they're ready to sell.



Initial Lead Qualification: Call new inquiries (from inbound calls or web forms) as soon as they come in. Have a friendly introductory conversation to gather information: Why might they sell? When? What's the property condition? Identify serious motivation versus casual interest. Ensure every new lead is contacted and categorized (hot, warm, long-term, etc.).



Set Appointments: When a lead is qualified and shows strong interest/motivation, schedule an appointment or transfer the call to our acquisitions closer. You control the calendar for our acquisition team – scheduling consultations or property visits. Make sure our closer gets all key information before the meeting.



Outbound Prospecting: Devote part of your time to reaching out to cold prospects from our premium data lists (such as probate, pre-foreclosure, or other niche lists we've pulled). Use cold calling or personalized texts/emails to introduce our service and see if they have a property they might consider selling. This "deep prospecting" uses the valuable data provided by our Data Manager to generate new leads beyond the ones who come to us.



Pipeline Organization: Keep the CRM updated meticulously. Log every call, update lead statuses, and add detailed notes after each contact. Set follow-up reminders for each lead so you always remember to call back when promised. No lead should ever be forgotten or left without a next action.



Team Coordination: Work closely with the acquisitions (closing) team. Clearly hand off highly motivated leads with full context (notes about the seller's situation, motivation level, etc.). After our closer makes an offer, circle back with the seller to address any concerns or continue nurturing if they didn't sign immediately. Essentially, you bridge the gap between initial interest and closed deal, keeping communication smooth.



Requirements:

Excellent Communication: Fluent English speaker who can converse naturally and confidently with U.S. homeowners. You have a friendly phone demeanor, active listening skills, and can build trust over multiple conversations. (Experience talking to older American homeowners is a plus – you can strike the right tone of patience and professionalism.)



Sales/Customer Service Experience: 1+ year in a role like sales representative, account manager, customer service, or any position requiring consistent client follow-up. Real estate experience (especially in investing or related to motivated sellers) is highly advantageous – if you've dealt with sellers or real estate leads before, let us know!



Follow-Up and Organizational Skills: A proven ability to juggle dozens of leads and keep an organized system. You never let a task or callback slip. Using a CRM or lead management system should be second nature to you. (If you pride yourself on color-coded spreadsheets or meticulous task lists, that's a good sign!)Google Drive



Persuasion & Empathy: You know how to connect with people, ask the right questions, and handle objections. You're empathetic to sellers' situations (many may be in tough circumstances like foreclosure, probate, etc.) and also persuasive in highlighting how our service can help them.



Tech-Savvy: Comfortable with CRM software, click-to-call phone systems, and general productivity tools (Google Workspace, etc.). Able to learn new apps quickly. Also, must have reliable internet and a headset/quiet workspace for frequent calls.

 hours in the US. Flexibility to occasionally adjust hours for an urgent lead is appreciated. We are seeking someone who can commit long-term (12+ months) and become an integral part of the team.



What We Offer:

Base Pay + Commission: Competitive base salary plus commission on each deal you help close. Your earning potential grows with every deal.

Impactful Work: This role is at the heart of our business – you will directly influence our revenue by turning leads into deals. It's rewarding to see your relationship-building result in a family helped and a successful transaction. We often deal with homeowners in difficult situations; you'll take pride in guiding them toward a solution.

Training & Development: We will provide training on our scripts, CRM, and the real estate investment process. You'll learn about the wholesale home-buying industry, negotiations, and how to evaluate seller motivation. Team Environment: Work with a supportive, growth-minded team. We maintain open communication and regular team check-ins despite being remote. You'll get feedback and recognition for your hard work. We also encourage new ideas – if you have suggestions to improve our follow-up processes, we want to hear them.



Remote Work Lifestyle: This is a 100% remote position. Save on commute time and work from the comfort of your home (or home office). As long as you can reliably cover the required hours and stay connected, you'll enjoy the flexibility of remote work.



How to Apply: If you're excited about nurturing leads and driving deals, we'd love to hear from you. Please send your resume and a short voice recording introducing yourself. title: B2B Content & Social Media Manager (Video + Ads)
description:
Read this first

I'm hiring one person to take over our content, social media and ads. If you're a content creator at heart who likes the marketing game and can ship every day without being chased, keep reading.



About Feight AI

We build custom AI solutions for manufacturers in Central Europe doing over €1M in annual revenue. The technical side is now staffed. I run sales, strategy and client relationships myself. What's missing is the engine that produces content, runs the social channels, and brings inbound interest from manufacturing decision-makers.

This is a blank canvas. No content, no funnel, no paid presence yet. The person we hire defines what good marketing at Feight AI looks like from scratch, with me holding the strategic frame and you producing the actual work.

What matters most

The single most important skill is content creation, especially video. Our organic growth across Meta, LinkedIn, YouTube and our blog depends on it, and our paid ads only work if the creative is strong. You produce content yourself, every day, consistently. That's the heart of this role.

Second to that is marketing sense. Enough to look at our numbers and tell me what's working and what isn't, and enough to have a real conversation about strategy. I hold the strategic frame. You execute and bring proposals.

What you'll be doing day to day



Producing 1 to 2 social posts per day, every working day, across our channels (Meta, LinkedIn, YouTube, blog). Mix of text, graphics, and video.

Creating short video content regularly. Editing, voiceover, visuals. This is the most important muscle.

Running Meta Ads when we launch them.

Building simple landing pages when needed for campaigns or lead magnets.

Tracking what works. You watch the numbers across channels and tell me what's worth doubling down on.



You probably



Create content yourself as your main skill, especially video. You can show us examples.

Have a marketing brain. Enough strategy sense to discuss what we should try next and why.

Are organized and self-directing. You ship every day without being chased.

Have a strong work ethic. If you say you'll publish something, it goes out, on time, at the quality you promised.

Learn fast. If you don't know LinkedIn Ads or a particular landing page tool yet, you figure it out in a week.

Communicate in English clearly and professionally.

Use AI tools daily for the actual work. We expect this, not just talk about it.

Want to earn more through results, not hours. The base is steady. The bonus is where it gets interesting.



This isn't a fit if



You don't personally create content. You manage other creators or "also write."

You can't be consistent. You need someone to chase you every day to ship.

You're motivated mainly by hourly pay, not by performance.

You expect detailed onboarding and three months to figure out the basics.



What we offer



$1,500/month base, paid reliably and on time.

Performance bonus tied to qualified leads and closed revenue. If your work drives sales, the bonus has no upper limit. This role exists for someone who wants the upside.

Room to grow. As Feight scales, this seat scales with it. Today's content + social manager becomes tomorrow's head of marketing with a team.

Fair, direct treatment. Clear expectations, no politics, predictable payments. We treat the people running important parts of our business like partners.

Remote work with autonomy. Work on your own rhythm as long as the work ships and the numbers move.



To apply

Start your message with the word PLAYBOOK on the first line, so we know you read the post. Anything without it gets skipped.



Then send us:



A short video, 1 to 2 minutes, where you introduce yourself. Who you are, what you've done, why this role caught your attention.

Three samples of content you've personally created. At least one of them should be video.

One or two examples of B2B or business marketing work you've done before. Show us what you've shipped and the thinking behind it.

Your full AI stack for marketing work. What tools you actually use for content, video, design, copy, ads, research. We want to see the whole setup, not just one tool.



Generic copy-paste applications get skipped. We would rather wait than fill the seat with the wrong person.

Next steps

Here's what happens after you send your application:



We'll get back to you within 5 business days.

If your application makes it through the first filter, we'll send you a short trial task. It should take less than an hour.

The top candidates from that round move on to an interview with the founder.



All the best,

FEIGHT AI Team

title: CRO Expert / Conversion Rate Optimization Specialist
description:
We are a U.S.-based performance growth partner working with home service companies. We scale our clients through paid acquisition, sales optimization, and full-funnel growth systems. We bring e-commerce-level marketing rigor into an industry that has been operating a decade behind.



We're hiring a CRO Expert to own conversion rate optimization across our client portfolio. Your job is to find every drop-off point in the funnel — from ad click to booked appointment — and systematically test, optimize, and lift conversion at every stage.



You'll be working on landing pages, lead forms, quiz funnels, booking flows, and the entire user journey from cold traffic to scheduled in-home consultation. Every percentage point you lift in conversion translates directly to client revenue, which is exactly the kind of impact we measure and reward.



**WHAT YOU'LL DO:**



- Audit landing pages, lead forms, quiz funnels, and booking flows across all client accounts

- Identify drop-off points using heatmaps, session recordings, and analytics (Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity, GA4, etc.)

- Build a structured CRO testing roadmap with clear hypotheses, success metrics, and prioritization

- Design and launch A/B tests on headlines, hooks, offers, form layouts, button placement, social proof, and page structure

- Optimize lead forms — field count, qualification questions, multi-step vs. single-step, mobile vs. desktop

- Improve quiz funnels and lead magnets for higher opt-in and qualification rates

- Optimize Thank You pages, confirmation flows, and post-booking experience

- Work directly with copywriters, designers, and developers to ship test variants quickly

- Track and report on conversion rates at every stage: ad click ? landing page ? lead ? booked appointment ? confirmed appointment

- Maintain a CRO testing log — every test documented with hypothesis, result, and learning

- Recommend funnel architecture improvements based on user behavior data



**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR:**



- 3+ years of hands-on CRO experience for lead-gen or e-commerce funnels

- Proven track record lifting conversion rates — you can point to specific tests, before/after numbers, and revenue impact

- Deep knowledge of landing page builders: Unbounce, Instapage, Leadpages, GoHighLevel, Funnelytics, Webflow, or similar

- Fluent in CRO analysis tools: Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity, GA4, Google Tag Manager, Mixpanel

- Strong understanding of A/B testing methodology, statistical significance, and test prioritization frameworks (ICE, PIE, etc.)

- Sharp eye for UX, copy, and design — you understand why pages convert, not just what to test

- Comfortable working with copywriters and designers to ship variants — you give clear, decisive creative feedback

- Strong written and spoken English — you'll be communicating directly with U.S. tea
mbers

- Analytical and methodical — you think in conversion rates, statistical confidence, and incremental lift

- Self-starter who can operate with full autonomy

- Reliable internet, quiet workspace, and ability to overlap with U.S. business hours

- No ego. Humble, hungry, and willing to dig into the messy work of testing and iteration



**BONUS POINTS:**



- Experience with home services, local services, or lead-gen funnels specifically

- Experience optimizing quiz funnels (
, Outgrow, Typeform, 
)

- Familiarity with GoHighLevel funnel building and automation

- Basic HTML, CSS, or no-code dev skills for rapid landing page edits

- Experience working with paid media teams (Meta, Google, TikTok) on creative-to-landing-page alignment

- Background in DTC or e-commerce CRO (we bring e-com principles into home services)

- Experience with multivariate testing, not just basic A/B

- Knowledge of mobile-first design and conversion best practices



**CULTURE:**



This is a relentless execution culture. We move fast, we test fast, we ship fast. We measure conversion lifts in basis points and revenue, not opinions. If you want a chill role where you write strategy docs that never get implemented, this isn't for you. If you want to ship tests every week and watch the numbers move, apply.



**HOW TO APPLY:**



Send your application with:



1. A 60-second video introducing yourself in English — pitch us on why we should hire you

2. Two specific CRO case studies — landing page or funnel, what you tested, before/after conversion rates, revenue impact

3. Screenshots of CRO tools you've used (Hotjar dashboards, A/B test results, GA4 reports — blur sensitive info if needed)

4. Links to landing pages or funnels you've personally built or optimized

5. Why you want this specific role



Applications without a video and case studies will not be considered.



---



**Wage/Salary:**

$1,200 – $2,500 USD/month + performance bonuses tied to conversion lift and client results

title: Growth Marketer — Acquisition (B2B / Manufacturing) - Content + Strategy Driven B2B Growth
description:
Read this first:



This post is for one specific person: a content-first growth marketer with genuine marketing intelligence, real B2B experience, and a serious work ethic. We are hiring one person. If that sounds like you, keep reading. 



Who we are:



Feight AI builds custom AI solutions for manufacturing companies in Central Europe doing over €1M in annual revenue. We design and build automation specifically for how each client actually runs their operations.



Our vision is simple. We want to be one of the top names companies in our region think of when they need serious AI work done for their business.



Where we are right now: the technical side is solid, the founder closes deals one to one, and the product works. What's missing is marketing. It's at zero. No content, no funnel, no paid presence.



That's the job. A blank canvas. The person we hire gets to define what good marketing at Feight AI looks like from scratch.



We're looking for the person who runs our entire acquisition function on the ground. What we need now is someone to take over content, channels and paid ads. Not as an assistant. As the person who owns this side of the business day to day.



What matters most:



Two things will d
 whether this works.



The first is content creation. Our organic growth on Meta, LinkedIn, YouTube and the blog depends on it, and our paid ads only work if the creative is strong. So we need a real creator. Someone who writes, edits, scripts, and ships content consistently and well.



The second is marketing intelligence. By that we mean the ability to look at the data and figure out what's actually going on. If a campaign is dying, you should be able to tell whether it's an audience problem, a message problem, an offer problem, or a channel problem, and what to try next. We give you the direction. You make it real on the ground and adjust as you go.



If both of these aren't your strong suit, this won't work.



What you'll be doing



Day to day you'll handle:



Posting and managing content across Meta (FB + IG), LinkedIn, YouTube and our blog.

Building funnels: landing pages, lead magnets,
 sequences.

Running paid ads (Meta/LinekdIn/Google): creative, audiences, budgets, testing, scaling.

Using AI tools to move faster than people who do this work manually.



You don't have to be a world expert at every one of these. Competent and resourceful is fine.



What we are not asking for:



No cold outreach. No warm outreach. We are not interested in that channel at the 
nt. The focus is content, funnels and ads.



Who we are hiring:



We are looking for someone who:



Creates content as their main skill. Not someone who "also writes" or manages other writers. You make the stuff yourself.

Can look at a week of data and tell us in five minutes what's working, what isn't, and what they'd change.

Is organized. You know your numbers, you report on a regular rhythm without being chased, and you come to us with proposals, not just observations.

Has actually driven B2B pipeline for international clients before. Real numbers, real results. Not just "campaigns you were part of."

Has B2B acquisition experience specifically. Not general agency work, not e-commerce, not social media management.

Has a strong work ethic. If you say you'll ship something, it ships. On time. At the quality you promised.

Actually likes this work. Hooks, funnels, ads, content. This is the kind of work you like to do.

Wants to earn more through results, not through hours. The base is steady. The bonus is where it gets interesting.

Communicates well, professionally, without us having to chase replies.

Doesn't need micromanaging. We give direction and context. You give back a working engine.

Can start moving fast. You don't need three months to figure out the basics.



This probably isn't for you if:



Content creation isn't your strongest skill.

You can execute a plan but you can't tell why something isn't working when the numbers go sideways.

You've never personally owned B2B acquisition outcomes.

You need long onboarding to figure out the basics.

Your background is general agency, e-commerce or social media management.

You're mainly motivated by hourly pay, not by performance.



What we offer



$1,500/month base, paid reliably and on time.

A performance bonus tied to qualified leads and closed revenue. If your work drives sales, the bonus has no upper limit. This role exists for someone who wants the upside.

Room to grow. As Feight scales, this seat scales with it. If things go well, today's Growth Lead becomes tomorrow's Head of Growth with a team underneath.

Fair, direct treatment. Clear expectations, no politics, predictable payments. We treat people running important parts of our business like partners.

Remote work with autonomy. Work on your own rhythm as long as the work ships and the numbers move.



To apply:



Start your message with the word PLAYBOOK on the first line, so we know you read the post. Anything without it gets skipped.



Then send us:



A short video, 1 to 2 minutes, where you introduce yourself. Who you are, what you've done, and why this role caught your attention.

Three samples of content you've personally created. At least one of them should be video.

Two or three B2B results you've personally driven. Numbers, links, before and after. The harder the proof, the better.

Your full AI stack for marketing work. What tools you actually use for content, funnels, design, copy, ads, research, anything else. We want to see the whole setup, not just one tool.



Generic copy-paste applications get skipped. We would rather wait than fill the seat with the wrong person.



Next steps:



Here's what happens after you send your application:



We'll get back to you within 5 business days.

If your application makes it through the first filter, we'll send you a short trial task. It should take less than an hour.

The top candidates from that round move on to an interview with the founder.



All the best,



FEIGHT AI Team.

I need someone who can help organize moving pieces, track projects, coordinate with my copywriter and clinic coordinator, manage documents, map funnels, and help me turn scattered ideas into clear, executable steps.



I run an established in-person acupuncture / Chinese medicine clinic, and I’m slowly building the online coaching / online education side of my business.



I’m also a full-time clinician, busy mom to a 2 year old, creative business owner/online content creator, and I have ADHD, so I often have a lot of ideas moving at once. At the same time, I’m building this in a realistic season of life. I am not looking for someone who pushes me to move faster just for the sake of moving fast. I need someone who can help me capture my ideas, organize them, prioritize what matters, and turn them into clear next steps without making everything feel urgent or overwhelming and I can take better action. My focus these days is everywhere, so keep me in check.



This role will start small because the online side of the business is still in the startup / buildout phase. I’m being thoughtful with budget and capacity, but I am looking for someone long-term. If the fit is strong and the online business grows, this role can grow in hours, responsibility, and pay over time.



About the Role



I’m one online creator / founder building the online education and coaching side of my business while still running my in-person clinic.



This is not a big corporate team or a fully built-out company with perfect systems. It’s me, my ideas, my content, my offers, and a small support team around me.



You’ll be working closely with me side by side, helping me organize the moving pieces, capture ideas, track next steps, and make sure things don’t fall through the cracks.



I need someone who is comfortable over-communicating in a helpful way. I would rather you ask, clarify, confirm, and update me than quietly disappear or assume.



A big part of this role is helping me take what’s in my head and turn it into something visible, organized, and actionable.



This could look like:



Listening to a Loom or voice note and turning it into a clean plan

Organizing scattered Google Docs across different accounts

Finding duplicate files and recommending the master version

Creating project trackers

Coordinating with my copywriter

Touching base with my clinic coordinator when needed

Checking what still needs my decision

Reminding me what’s pending

Helping me prioritize what actually matters next

About the Stage of the Business



This role is for someone who is comfortable joining during the startup / buildout phase of the online side of my business.



My in-person clinic is established, but the online coaching / online education side is still being built. That means the systems are not perfect yet. Some documents live in different Google Drives. Some projects are still in idea form. Some funnels are still being mapped. My signature system and coaching container are still being organized.



That is part of why I’m hiring.



I need someone who is not intimidated by a business that is still taking shape. I need someone who can help bring structure, clarity, and follow-through while things are being built.



This is not a polished corporate role where everything is already systemized. This is a chance to help build the operating system of a growing online health coaching / education brand from the ground up.



I already have support from a copywriter and clinic coordinator, and this role will involve helping coordinate between people, projects, tools, documents, and ideas.



The role will start lean, around 5–10 hours per week, because I am being thoughtful with budget and capacity. But I am looking for someone long-term. If the fit is strong and the online business grows, there is room for this role to grow in hours, responsibility, and pay over time.



Who I’m Looking For



You are not just a task-taker.



You are a systems thinker, strong communicator, and organized follow-through person. You can take a messy brain dump and turn it into a clean plan, project tracker, funnel map, folder system, or task list.



You are proactive. You notice what’s missing. You follow up without being asked. You over-communicate in a helpful way. You can manage up and keep me updated without me having to chase you.



I need someone who can help organize the chaos without killing the creativity.



Personality-wise, I’m looking for someone warm, steady, intuitive, organized, and marketing-minded. Someone who can bring calm to the chaos, help me see the big picture, and keep things moving without adding pressure. Tell me when things are time sensitive and what I need to get ahead of. I want to be able to turn off from work at times to be a present mom because you are handling it. 



Experience with online health coaches, online educators, wellness brands, course creators, or service-based online businesses is strongly preferred.



This Role Is For Someone Who Can Help With

 and sales copy

mbers

Kit / ConvertKit

mbers

Ongoing Role & Pay

$10–$12/hr depending on experience
