title: Social Media Manager & Digital Growth Specialist
description:
US Panels — Job Description

Social Media Manager & Digital Growth Specialist



Type: Full-Time · Remote

Experience: 3–5 Years

Industry: Commercial Construction / Building Materials



Social Media Management   ·   SEO   ·   PPC   ·   Website Optimization   ·   AI Marketing Tools



ROLE OVERVIEW



US Panels manufactures insulated metal panel (IMP) systems serving cold storage, warehouse, food processing, data center, and industrial construction markets. We are scaling our digital presence and need someone who can take our content and turn it into reach, traffic, and leads.

The Social Media Manager & Digital Growth Specialist owns our front-facing digital presence: social media channels, paid campaigns, SEO performance, and the website itself. You will work hand-in-hand with the content creator to publish and distribute assets, and you will use AI tools to accelerate every part of that process — from scheduling and copywriting to ad optimization and SEO analysis. This role is equal parts creative and analytical.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



Social Media Management & Publishing

• Own day-to-day management of all company social accounts: LinkedIn, YouTube, TikTok, Instagram,
, and X 
).

• Publish content on a consistent, platform-optimized schedule using a shared content calendar.

• Write or adapt captions, hashtags, and post copy for each platform's audience and algorithm.

• Monitor all channels for comments, messages, and mentions — respond promptly and professionally.

• Engage proactively with followers, construction industry accounts, and relevant conversations to grow organic reach.

• Identify and engage with potential prospects and partners through social listening and community participation.

Content Distribution & Campaign Execution

• Receive content assets from the content creator and distribute them across platforms with platform-specific formatting and copy.

• Run boosted post and paid social campaigns on LinkedIn and Meta to amplify high-performing organic content.

• Develop and execute targeted social ad campaigns designed to reach architects, GCs, developers, and cold storage facility owners.

• Manage campaign budgets, targeting parameters, and creative testing for all paid social activity.

SEO Optimization

• Own on-page SEO across the company website: meta titles and descriptions, header structure, internal linking, image alt text, and keyword placement.

• Conduct ongoing keyword research to identify high-value search opportunities in commercial construction and IMP-related topics.

• Monitor keyword rankings, organic traffic trends, and technical SEO health using Google Search Console, SEMrush, or Ahrefs.

• Coordinate with the content creator to ensure new articles and pages are SEO-optimized before publishing.

• Identify and flag technical SEO issues (crawl errors, page speed, mobile usability) and work to resolve them.

PPC & Paid Search

• Build, manage, and optimize Google Ads campaigns targeting commercial construction search terms.

• Set up and refine ad groups, keyword match types, negative keyword lists, and bidding strategies.

• Write ad copy and test variations to improve click-through rates and quality scores.

• Monitor spend, CPC, conversion rates, and ROAS; optimize campaigns weekly to improve efficiency.

• Coordinate landing page messaging with active PPC campaigns to maximize conversion.

Website Management & Landing Page Optimization

• Manage and update website content in WordPress or the company CMS — page copy, images, CTAs, and layout.

• Build and improve landing pages for campaigns, lead magnets, and product categories.

• Run A/B tests on page elements (headlines, CTAs, form placement) to improve conversion rates.

• Ensure the website is current, professional, and aligned with active marketing campaigns at all times.

• Identify UX issues that create friction for visitors and work with available resources to resolve them.

AI Marketing Tools

• Use AI tools to accelerate social caption writing, ad copy generation, headline testing, and keyword research.

• Apply AI scheduling and optimization tools to improve posting timing and engagement prediction.

• Stay current on AI marketing tools and bring new capabilities into the workflow proactively.

• Use AI-powered analytics tools to surface insights from social and website performance data faster.

Analytics & Reporting

• Track and report weekly or monthly on: social follower growth, engagement rates, reach, website traffic, keyword rankings, PPC performance, and leads generated.

• Use Google Analytics, Search Console, and platform analytics to build a clear picture of what is driving results.

• Provide actionable performance summaries to leadership with clear recommendations, not just numbers.

• Monitor competitor digital presence and identify opportunities to outperform them in search and social.



REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE



Social Media Management

• 3–5 years managing professional or B2B social accounts across LinkedIn, YouTube, TikTok, Instagram,
, and X.

• Proven ability to grow followers and engagement on professional audiences — not just consumer brands.

• Experience with social scheduling tools: Hootsuite, Buffer, Sprout Social, or similar.

SEO

• Solid working knowledge of on-page SEO: keyword placement, meta optimization, internal linking, and technical SEO basics.

• Hands-on experience with SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Search Console, and Google Analytics.

• Ability to coordinate SEO strategy with a content team rather than working in isolation.

Paid Advertising (PPC & Paid Social)

• Experience managing Google Ads campaigns — search, display, or both.

• Experience running paid social campaigns on LinkedIn Ads and/or Meta Ads Manager.

• Comfortable managing budgets, writing ad copy, and optimizing campaigns based on performance data.

Website Management

• Comfortable publishing and editing content in WordPress, HubSpot CMS, Webflow, or a comparable platform.

• Ability to build or improve landing pages without relying on a developer for routine updates.

• Basic understanding of UX and conversion rate optimization principles.

AI Tools

• Working knowledge of AI tools for marketing tasks: content generation, caption writing, ad copy, and analytics summaries.

• Ability to incorporate AI into a daily workflow to operate efficiently at a high output level.

Analytics

• Proficient in Google Analytics and platform-native analytics for social and paid channels.

• Ability to interpret data, draw conclusions, and translate findings into actionable recommendations.



PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS



• Experience marketing construction, building materials, or industrial/technical B2B products.

• Background in both organic social growth and paid campaign management.

• Familiarity with HubSpot or Pipedrive CRM and how social and paid activity connects to pipeline.

• Experience with conversion rate optimization and landing page testing.



TOOLS USED IN THIS ROLE



LinkedIn / TikTok / YouTube / Meta   ·   Google Ads / LinkedIn Ads   ·   Google Analytics / Search Console



SEMrush / Ahrefs   ·   WordPress / HubSpot CMS   ·   Hootsuite / Buffer / Sprout Social

Please submit the following:

7. Resume or CV

We are building a content engine that educates the construction industry, drives inbound traffic, and establishes US Panels as the go-to authority in our space.

The AI Content Creator is responsible for producing the full range of assets that power our marketing: written articles, blogs, newsletters, social copy, AI-generated images, and video content. This is a modern content role built around AI-assisted workflows — you will use today's best AI tools to create high volumes of quality content efficiently, without sacrificing accuracy, brand voice, or technical credibility. You are creative, organized, and genuinely excited about what AI tools can do when put in the right hands.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



AI-Assisted Written Content

Newsletters &
 Content

 content aligns with active outreach campaigns.

• $5–$7/hour depending on experience

• Retention bonus starting at $200 at every 6-month anniversary, with performance-based increases

• Room for advancement — as our team grows, we promote from within. High performers will have the opportunity to take on leadership roles managing our Philippines-based team

• Long-term position — we value loyalty and invest in people who invest in us





What You’ll Do

• Manage caregiver schedules in WellSky and ensure all client shifts are covered (training on WellSky provided)

• Handle call-offs, no-shows, and last-minute schedule changes quickly and calmly

• Answer inbound calls via RingCentral from caregivers, clients, and families

title: Content Workflow & Systems VA (No Video Editing, No Strategy)
description:
READ THIS FIRST – THIS IS A SYSTEMS ROLE (NO VIDEO EDITING, NO STRATEGY)



If you want to be a “creative” or editor, this is NOT the job for you.



I’m Stefan, founder of Status Alpha – a high-ticket mentorship for men who want elite body, energy, mindset and performance.



I have already built a detailed Content Operating System (Google Drive structure, Content Tracker, SOPs, Loom trainings). I shoot content and drop it into a Drive INBOX. I need a Content Workflow & Systems VA who loves structure and can run the machine so I don’t have to think about it.



Your mission: take every video I drop into Drive and, using my SOPs, turn it into organized assets and scheduled posts across Instagram,
, TikTok, YouTube and LinkedIn.



This is FULL-TIME and LONG-TERM for someone in the Philippines with very strong written English and experience supporting coaches/creators.



WHAT THIS JOB IS (YOUR DAILY WORK)



You will NOT do video editing.

You will NOT design graphics.

You will NOT invent content strategy.



You WILL:



1) Handle content intake & organization

– Check a Google Drive INBOX for new videos.

– Move files into the correct folders (RAW, PROOF, Stefan Asset Bank).

– Create/update rows in a Google Sheets Content Tracker (AssetID, file path, type, status, transcript level, etc.).



2) Create and clean transcripts

– Upload videos to transcription tools.

– Paste transcripts into Google Docs.

– Fix grammar, misheard words, punctuation and formatting so they read like a native wrote them (especially for testimonials, VSLs and “hero” videos).



3) Build editor briefs and manage revisions

– Use AI tools + my prompts to generate editor briefs.

– Copy the brief into a Clip Brief template (Google Doc).

– Fill in Meta info (source file links, goals, etc.).

– Add simple thumbnail notes (text + which folder to pull photos from).

– Coordinate with the editor:

  • Move status from Raw ? Briefed ? Editing ? Needs Revision ? Approved.

  • Watch drafts, write clear revision notes, and approve final versions.



4) Schedule and publish content (NO editing)

– Take finished assets from the “Approved” folders.

– Schedule posts in:

  • Meta Business Suite (IG/FB)

  • TikTok Scheduler

  • YouTube Studio

  • LinkedIn native scheduler

– Use provided captions/CTAs and make sure dates/times and platforms are correct.



5) Log performance monthly

– Once a month, open platform Insights.

– Add the top performing posts to a “Viral_Log” sheet (URL, views, saves, etc.).

– Write 3–10 simple bullet-point learnings (patterns), NOT complex analytics.



You will get Looms and written SOPs for all of this. Your job is to FOLLOW them, IMPROVE small things, and KEEP EVERYTHING ON TIME.



WHAT THIS JOB IS NOT



– NOT a video editor role (if you want to edit, don’t apply).

– NOT a “content manager / strategist” role.

– NOT a social media “ideas” job.

– NOT part-time or side-gig work.



This is a **workflow / systems VA** role. Think operations, not creativity.



REQUIREMENTS (MUST-HAVES)



– Written English: 9/10 or close (without AI).

  • You can fix transcripts and captions so they read like a native wrote them.

  • You notice grammar, spelling and punctuation mistakes on your own.



– Experience supporting at least ONE coach/creator/personal brand with:

  • Google Drive organization

  • Content calendars / trackers

  • Editor/creative coordination

  • Scheduling posts on multiple platforms



– You actually LIKE:

  • SOPs

  • Loom trainings

  • Checklists

  • Keeping things clean and consistent



– Comfortable with:

  • Google Drive / Docs / Sheets

  • Meta Business Suite / basic platform schedulers

  • Simple video tools ONLY for transcripts and checking (CapCut auto captions, YouTube transcripts, etc.)



– Extremely organized and detail-oriented:

  • You don’t “forget” to update the sheet.

  • You keep folders clean.

  • You follow processes exactly and suggest improvements once you understand them.



SCHEDULE & PAY



– Hours: around 35–40 hours per week

– Time: mostly PH evenings (to overlap with US time) + light weekend coverage (1–3 hours on Sat/Sun for checks/scheduling)

– Pay: USD $500–700/month long term, depending on how well you can run the system



This is a long-term role. If we’re a good fit, I want you in this seat for 12+ months.



WHO THIS IS FOR



– You like being the person who “keeps everything moving.”

– You get satisfaction from a clean Drive, up-to-date tracker, and posts going out on time.

– You want a stable, full-time role with clear expectations where you can become “the person who runs the content machine.”



WHO THIS IS NOT FOR



– You want to be a video editor, creator or strategist.

– You only want 10–20 hours/week or short-term work.

– You dislike repetitive tasks, even when they matter.

– You are not strong in written English.



HOW TO APPLY (FOLLOW EXACTLY)



Use this subject line / OnlineJobs title:

CONTENT WORKFLOW VA – [Your First Name]



In your message, include **short answers** to:



1) Experience:

– Briefly describe the BEST coach/creator you worked with and what you did for their content day-to-day (max 5 sentences).



2) Transcripts & English:

– On a scale of 1–10, how strong is your WRITTEN English (without AI)?

– In 3–5 sentences, tell me why you can be trusted to fix transcripts for important videos (testimonials, VSLs, live trainings).



3) Tools:

– Which tools have you used for:

  a) Transcription

  b) Scheduling posts

  c) Google Drive organization

  d) Video review / basic checks (CapCut/YT, etc.)



4) Hours & Pay:

– How many hours/week can you commit?

– Are you able to work PH evenings + some weekend time?

– What monthly salary (within the $500–700 range) would you be happy with long-term?



5) Proof:

– Links or screenshots from ONE coach/creator you supported (social accounts, a Drive structure screenshot with names blurred, or anything that shows you’ve done this kind of work).



Applications that do not follow these steps will be ignored.



I’m looking for ONE person who wants to own this role long-term and run the system with pride.

* Introduce themselves

title: Repurposing Editor (Finds the Moments in Long Form)
description:
Most editors transcode. We need one with judgment. Watch a 20 minute video, find the 30 seconds worth keeping, cut it. That's the job.



The skill we're paying for is knowing what to cut OUT. Half of taste is restraint. You should be able to defend every cut you make in one sentence.



You should know what makes someone stop scrolling. You should know the difference between a 
nt that cuts itself and one you have to force.



The trial tests this directly. We give you a 90 second window. You find the 
nt.



Brief in 24 hours of application. Onboarded in 7 days. Weekly volume.



Application must start with your per-clip rate. Then: portfolio, software, hours per week, and 3 channels you watch specifically for repurposing inspiration.

title: Motion Graphics Editor (After Effects, Animated Text + Lower Thirds)
description:
After Effects specialist. Animated text overlays, lower thirds, transitions, brand intros, chapter cards.



You should know when motion adds and when it distracts. You should know the difference between motion design that supports the content and motion design that competes with it. You should know clean typography from busy typography.



We don't want plugin spam. We don't want every transition to be a wipe. We want restrained, intentional motion that serves the cut.



You'll work alongside our base editors who hand off projects for your motion layer.



Trial brief in 24 hours of application. Onboarded in 7 days. 3 to 5 projects per week once active.



Application must start with your hourly rate. Then: AE-focused portfolio, software, hours per week, and one motion design trend you think is overrated plus one you think is underrated.

title: Podcast Editor (Audio Cleanup + Multi-Cam Video Edit)
description:
Edit podcast episodes for personal brand channels. Audio cleanup first (noise reduction, leveling, EQ), then video cut with B-roll inserts, captions, and chapter markers.



You should know when audio repair is worth it and when the take is too far gone. You should know how to cut a 90 minute conversation into chapters that actually work, not arbitrary 15 minute blocks. You should know when to use multi-cam for emphasis and when to stay on one shot.



Premiere plus Adobe Audition or DaVinci. Multi-cam experience required.



Trial brief in 24 hours. Onboarded in 7 days. 1 to 2 episodes per week per channel.



Application must start with your hourly rate. Then: portfolio with podcast work, software, hours per week, and 2 podcasts you study for both audio AND video edit quality.

title: Video Editor + Thumbnail Designer (Combo Role)
description:
Rare combo role. Edit videos AND design YouTube thumbnails. Premiere plus Photoshop or Figma required.



For the edit side: you should know where retention drops and how to fix it.



For the thumbnail side: you should know thumbnail psychology. Why MrBeast's thumbnails work. Why Veritasium's work differently. Why most channels' thumbnails fail at small sizes on a phone.



We want someone who can run a channel's full visual identity, not someone strong on one craft and weak on the other.



3 to 5 deliverables per week (mix of edits and thumbs). Trial brief in 24 hours. Onboarded in 7 days.



Application must start with your hourly rate. Then send TWO portfolios (video edits AND thumbnails), software, hours per week, and one thumbnail from a channel you think is underrated.

title: Junior Editor (We'll Train You, Path to Mid-Tier in 60 Days)
description:
unior editor with at least 6 months of editing experience. We'll train you on our exact style and workflow.



What we need from you: coachability and obsession with getting good. We don't expect senior taste yet. We expect that you study editors who are better than you, take feedback without ego, and improve fast.



You should already be watching long-form YouTube and Shorts as a student of the craft. You should be able to articulate why a video held you or lost you.



If you've been editing for 6 months and can't tell us what makes a good cut versus a bad one, you're not ready.



Trial brief in 24 hours of application. Onboarded in 7 days for whoever passes. Daily availability required for the first 2 weeks of training.



Application must start with your current hourly rate. Then: portfolio, software, your availability for weeks 1-2, and 3 editors you're learning from right now.

title: Part-Time Editor for Overflow (3-5 Projects per Week)
description:
Already have a day job or other clients? Good. We need a part time editor for overflow.



What matters here is dependability and dialed judgment. We send work, you accept or pass. A reliable 48 hour turnaround matters more than speed.



You should already know what works in your format. We don't have time to teach taste at this rate. You should be able to take a brief, deliver the cut, and get it right the first time.



No retainer. Per project pay.



Trial brief in 24 hours of application. Onboarded in 7 days.



Application must start with your per-project rate. Then: portfolio, software, current weekly capacity, and one editor whose work you actively study.

title: Senior AI Search & Local SEO Lead (Contract-to-Hire)
description:
# Senior AI Search & Local SEO Lead (Contract-to-Hire)



## Overview



We are a U.S.-based company that owns and operates a large portfolio of local lead generation websites and Google Business Profiles across multiple home service industries.



We are seeking a Senior AI Search & Local SEO Lead to help improve visibility across traditional local search and emerging AI-powered search platforms.



This is a hands-on execution role. We are looking for someone who can build, optimize, solve problems, create systems, document processes, train tea
mbers, and eventually become the owner of the AI Search and Local SEO function within the company.



Our long-term goal is to build a self-managing department with clear systems, measurable performance metrics, documented processes, and strong operational ownership.



Experience working with local service businesses, lead generation websites, or rank-and-rent websites is highly preferred.



This is a full-time contract-to-hire opportunity with significant long-term growth potential.



---



## Responsibilities



### AI Search



* Improve visibility across AI-powered search platforms

* Research and test emerging AI Search strategies

* Analyze citation, entity, authority, trust, and recommendation signals

* Develop repeatable AI Search optimization processes

* Track and measure AI Search visibility improvements



### Local SEO



* Improve Google Business Profile rankings

* Conduct SEO audits

* Improve local heatmap rankings

* Optimize local landing pages

* Improve topical authority and local relevance

* Develop authority-building strategies

* Implement content and internal linking improvements



### Websites & Systems



* Build and optimize WordPress websites and landing pages

* Implement schema and SEO improvements

* Improve site architecture, internal linking, and user experience

* Create SOPs, workflows, and training documentation

* Build scalable systems and quality-control processes



### Leadership



* Work closely with existing tea
mbers

* Train and develop supporting tea
mbers

* Establish standards and best practices

* Help build a scalable, self-managing department

* Eventually become the owner of the AI Search and Local SEO function



---



## Required Skills



* Strong Local SEO experience

* Google Business Profile optimization

* WordPress website development and optimization

* SEO auditing

* Schema markup

* Strong AI prompting skills

* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities

* Excellent written and spoken English

* SOP and documentation creation

* Ability to work independently and take ownership



---



## Success Metrics



Success will be measured primarily by:



* Improved Google Business Profile rankings as measured through heatmaps

* Improved AI Search visibility and recommendations

* Creation of effective SOPs, systems, and documentation

* Ability to train and elevate supporting tea
mbers

* Increased department autonomy through systems, documentation, and team development



---



## Initial 90-Day Evaluation



The selected candidate will complete company-provided AI Search and Local SEO training and then be assigned a small portfolio of websites and Google Business Profiles.



Responsibilities during this period will include:



* Auditing opportunities

* Creating implementation plans

* Executing improvements

* Tracking results

* Creating SOPs and documentation



Performance will be evaluated primarily on:



* Measurable improvements in Google Business Profile rankings (tracked through heatmaps)

* Measurable improvements in AI Search visibility and recommendations

* Quality of execution

* Quality of documentation

* Ownership and problem-solving ability



Candidates who demonstrate strong results, leadership potential, and system-building ability will have the opportunity to take ownership of this function long-term.



---



## To Apply



### 1. SEO & GBP Results (Required)



Provide 2–3 examples of local SEO campaigns you personally worked on, including:



* Website URL

* Google Business Profile URL (if applicable)

* Heatmap URLs (preferred) or screenshots

* Results achieved

* Your specific role in the project



For at least one example, briefly explain the SEO improvements you personally implemented and the impact those changes had on rankings, visibility, or traffic.



### 2. SOP Example (Required)



Provide an example of a SOP, workflow, checklist, training document, or process you personally created.



### 3. AI Workflow



Briefly explain how you currently use AI tools within your SEO workflow.



### 4. AI Search Experience (Preferred)



Provide examples of businesses you have helped improve visibility in:



* ChatGPT

* Google AI Overviews

* Gemini

* Perplexity



Include evidence or screenshots if available.



### 5. Loom Video (Required)



Please record a 3–5 minute Loom video covering:



* Brief introduction

* Your Local SEO experience

* Your AI Search experience

* The SEO project you are most proud of

* Why you believe you are a strong fit for this role



Include the Loom link in your application.



### 6. Why You Are a Strong Fit



Tell us why you believe you are a strong fit for this role.



---



Please begin your application with:



**"I focus on results, systems, and ownership."**

title: Online Math/Science Teacher(Near-Native Accent)
description:
About Pomelo Academy

Pomelo Academy is an innovative online international school dedicated to delivering high-quality education to students worldwide. We provide a dynamic and engaging learning environment, catering to individualized instruction that transcends geographical boundaries.



Job Description

We are seeking passionate and experienced Near-Native English-speaking Online K-12 Math and/or Science Teachers with verifiable teaching certifications. The ideal candidates will have strong academic backgrounds in Mathematics and/or Science, experience teaching young learners (ages 5–18), and a commitment to creating a supportive, inquiry-based, and engaging online learning environment.



Responsibilities



Deliver interactive and engaging Math and/or Science lessons to individuals and small groups of 2–6 students aged 5–18.

Teach using internationally recognized curricula such as A Closer Look, Glencoe Science, Pearson Interactive Science, NGSS-aligned resources, Singapore Math, or IB/AP/A Level Math programs.

Create age-appropriate lesson plans focused on conceptual understanding, inquiry, problem-solving, and real-world applications.

Incorporate visuals, multimedia, and hands-on virtual activities to make abstract concepts accessible and engaging.

Monitor student progress and provide timely feedback to students and parents.

Foster curiosity, discussion, and active learning in a safe and supportive space.



Qualifications



Professional teacher with at least 2 years of teaching experience (Kindergarten–Grade 12).

Must hold a valid teaching license/certification (e.g., Teaching License, State Certification). TESOL/TEFL is a plus.

Near-native English accent with excellent spoken and written communication skills.

Strong academic background in Mathematics and/or Science (Biology, Physics, Chemistry, General Science).

Experience teaching in public/international schools or reputable online platforms.

Familiarity with inquiry-based and/or interdisciplinary approaches (e.g., STEM/STEAM).

Comfortable working between 07:00–22:00 (Weekdays) and 9:00–22:00 (Weekends), GMT+8.

Proficiency with digital platforms such as ClassIn, Microsoft Office, and other educational technologies.

Must have a stable and fast internet connection and a PC/laptop with at least Windows 10 or Mac OS Catalina.



Benefits



Flexible working hours.

Opportunity to teach using globally respected Math and Science curricula.

Be part of an international, passionate team of educators.

Access to training and professional development.

Regular enrollment model (not a booking system), ensuring schedule stability and consistency

title: Executive Assistant for U.S. Immigration Lawyer & Law School Director
description:
Professional

Type: Part-Time | Fully Remote | International Candidates Welcome

Hours: Approximately 20 hours/week

Compensation: $6/hour

Time Zone Requirement: Availability to overlap with US Pacific Time (PT) during core hours



About the Principal

You will be supporting a San Francisco-based immigration attorney, federal litigator, law school director, and university lecturer whose work spans multiple high-stakes professional environments simultaneously.



His current roles include:



Director & Staff Attorney at a newly established federal immigration litigation clinic filing habeas corpus petitions in U.S. District Courts, supervising law students, mentoring pro bono practitioners, and fundraising.

Founding Attorney of a premier San Francisco immigration law firm handling complex cases including asylum, removal defense, business and investor visas, family-based immigration, and federal habeas corpus petitions, with a multilingual staff and an outstanding client reputation.

University Lecturer teaching advanced legal research and writing to graduate law students.

ESL Instructor teaching literacy-level students, many of whom are immigrants and refugees.



This is not a routine administrative role. You will be supporting a principal whose daily work involves federal court deadlines, law student supervision, client emergencies, grant writing, academic course management, and community outreach — often all in the same week. The right candidate will take ownership of key administrative and operational systems so the principal can stay focused on high-level legal, academic, and strategic work.



Key Responsibilities

1. Executive Calendar & Communications



Own and manage a complex, multi-context calendar spanning court deadlines, academic commitments, client meetings, and community engagements

Triage incoming communications by urgency and context; draft professional correspondence on behalf of the principal

Proactively flag scheduling conflicts, deadline overlaps, and risks before they arise



2. Legal Clinic & Academic Administration



Track litigation docket deadlines, court filing windows, and student clinic milestones

Assist with logistics for conferences, CLE events, and practitioner training sessions

Support grant research and reporting: tracking deadlines and organizing submission materials

Coordinate between the principal, faculty colleagues, clinic students, and pro bono practitioners



3. Law Firm Operations



Liaise with the firm's internal team to ensure smooth daily operations

Support client intake workflows: organizing forms, tracking missing documents, and following up

Assist with digital marketing: maintain content calendars, coordinate post scheduling, and track engagement across social media platforms

Help maintain organized digital case file systems across firm platforms



4. Academic Course Support



Organize and upload course materials including syllabi, rubrics, and lesson plans across learning management platforms

Manage student communications, deadlines, and logistical updates with sensitivity to multilingual populations



5. Research & Special Projects



Conduct preliminary research on assigned topics and prepare concise briefing summaries

Support community-facing writing projects including articles and public-facing content

Adapt flexibly to shifting priorities as needed





Required Qualifications



3+ years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Operations Manager, or Project Manager — ideally supporting a principal with multiple concurrent professional roles

Exceptional written and spoken English with the ability to draft polished professional communications

Tech proficiency across Google Workspace, Zoom, Slack, project management tools (Asana/ClickUp/Notion), and AI productivity tools; legal practice management software experience is a plus

Strong organizational instincts — comfort managing competing deadlines across entirely different professional contexts

Reliable overlap with US Pacific Time during core working hours



Preferred Qualifications



Prior experience supporting attorneys, law firms, or academic institutions

Familiarity with immigration law workflows or federal court processes

Experience working with or teaching ESL/multilingual populations





What You'll Gain



Exposure to federal immigration litigation, legal clinical education, and law firm operations at a high level

A mission-driven environment serving immigrant communities

100% remote flexibility from anywhere in the world

Competitive part-time compensation commensurate with experience





How to Apply

Please submit the following with the subject line: EA Application — [Your Name]

Your resume or CV

One writing sample demonstrating your professional written communication skills (if available)

description:

 and Sky Watch TV 
 are good reference points. Each compilation is about 10 minutes long (8-10 clips, roughly 4 hours of work), and I produce about 3 per week, so this is steady, ongoing work.



My budget is $20 per compilation. The channel isn't monetized yet so I'm keeping costs lean, but for the right editor this becomes a regular gig with high monthly volume.



To apply, start your message with the word ORBS so I know you actually read this, and include your portfolio plus 1-2 samples closest to the style above. From the strongest applicants I'll invite a few to a quick test — editing the first 3 minutes of a sample clip — before we begin the regular ongoing work. Thanks!

title: Web Infrastructure & Cloud Operations Specialist (Contract-to-Hire)
description:
# Web Infrastructure & Cloud Operations Specialist (Contract-to-Hire)



We are seeking a reliable, detail-oriented Web Infrastructure & Cloud Operations Specialist to help manage and improve a large portfolio of websites.



This is a full-time contract-to-hire role with a 60–90 day evaluation period and the opportunity for a long-term position.



We are currently migrating websites from WordPress to static sites while improving infrastructure, backups, monitoring, documentation, and operational standards. We are looking for someone who can take ownership of infrastructure-related tasks, improve systems, document processes, and help build a scalable operation.



**This role is best suited for someone who enjoys building systems, creating documentation, solving problems proactively, and improving operational efficiency.**



## Core Responsibilities



* Manage Cloudflare configuration and maintenance

* Manage DNS, SSL, and domain-related tasks

* Execute website migrations, including WordPress-to-static-site migrations

* Perform migration QA and validation testing

* Validate backups and perform restore testing

* Set up and maintain monitoring systems

* Support WordPress hosting and infrastructure

* Assist with AWS-related tasks

* Troubleshoot website, hosting, DNS, SSL, and Cloudflare issues

* Create and maintain SOPs and technical documentation

* Help standardize infrastructure and reduce technical debt

title: Video Editor - Short and Long Form

Organise and back up raw footage and project files in our shared drive

Experience editing for trades, construction, property, architecture, or interiors

Understanding of what performs well on Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube

You'll also be designing YouTube thumbnails that stop the scroll and drive click-through rate, so a strong visual eye is a must.

• Are highly skilled in Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects (these are non-negotiable)

• Have a strong portfolio of long-form, talking-head style content you've edited

• Are a creative, collaborative person who enjoys being part of a team

Requirements:

• Full-time availability, 40 hours per week

• A strong portfolio showcasing long-form talking-head content (please include this with your application - applications without a portfolio will not be considered)

title: Full-Stack Engineer (Node + React) - Long- Term, Full-Time, Real Estate Tech Startup
description:
ABOUT US

We are building a new kind of real estate platform in the United States. It is called The Buyer Listing Service.

Today, real estate websites only show homes that are for sale. We are building the buy side of the market for real estate agents. On our platform, real estate agents post buyer want-listings, not for sale listings. Our system then uses AI to match both buyer agents and seller agents together. We work directly with the official real estate databases (called MLSs) that agents use across the US. More of these databases are signing up with us every month and we're growing fast. 



We are a small and fast-moving team. When you write code here, it ships quickly and real people use it. This is a rare chance to help build a brand-new product from a growth stage, take real ownership, and grow with the company.



THE KIND OF PERSON WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We are looking for an experienced engineer who can work independently. Over time, you will own and run large parts of this platform. We are relying on your expertise. This is not a junior role and we are not looking for someone we train from the basics. If you need a senior developer checking all of your work, this is not the right fit. If you want real ownership and the chance to be the technical expert on a growing product, it is a great fit.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

• Build and improve features across our website and our backend API

• Review and merge code changes (we use a clean pull request workflow on GitHub)

• Connect and clean real estate data from different sources so it fits our system

• Use AI tools (like Claude) to help map and clean messy data

• Work closely with the founder and one other developer, and increasingly own your areas

    

YOU MUST HAVE

• 4+ years of professional full-stack experience, and the proven ability to work on your own

• Strong fundamentals, not just frameworks. You can explain how JavaScript works (for example, the event loop), how the web works, and how to model and query a SQL database.

• Strong skills in Node.js and Express

• Strong skills in React

• Comfortable writing raw SQL (we use MySQL, no ORM)

• Real experience integrating and cleaning messy data and APIs from other systems

• A habit of learning on your own. You have personal projects or things you built to teach yourself.

• Clean Git habits and small, focused pull requests

• Good written English (most of our work is async and in writing)

• Able to follow written rules and instructions exactly



HOW WE THINK ABOUT AI

We use AI tools like Claude every day and we want people who use them well. But we are hiring an experienced engineer, not a person who copies and pastes from a chatbot. You should be able to explain why your code works, and fix it when the AI gives a wrong answer. In our process we will always ask you to explain your decisions, so deep experience matters more than fast answers.



NICE TO HAVE

• Experience with AWS

• Experience using AI or LLMs (Claude, OpenAI, etc.) in real projects • Experience with data pipelines or ETL



HOW WE WORK

• We write small, focused changes. We do not refactor code that is not part of the task.

• We follow a written set of rules for the codebase. Following instructions matters more here than working fast.

• We welcome AI tools. We want people who use them well to do more.



HOURS

Full-time, 40 hours per week. We would like you to work US East Coast hours if you can. This helps you work at the same time as the rest of the team.



HOW TO APPLY

1. Start your message with the word BLUEPRINT so we know you read this post.

2. Send a link to one project you built and are proud of. Tell us in 2 or 3 sentences what it does, what part you built, and why you built it that way. Be ready to explain your choices on a call.

3. Tell us your experience with Node, React, and SQL, and the largest project you have owned or led.

4. Tell us if you have used AI or LLM tools in your work, and how.

Our process is a short call, then a deeper technical interview, then a small paid task using fake data, then a short call to walk through your code together. We will reply to strong applicants.

Your Core Responsibilities

/Facebook Groups, Reddit, Instagram, YouTube, and Pinterest.

, Instagram, Reddit, YouTube, or Pinterest.

title: STR Bookkeeper
description:
DO NOT APPLY IF YOU HAVEN'T BEEN A BOOKKEEPER AT A SHORT TERM RENTAL/VACATION RENTAL COMPANY



Role: Bookkeeper

We are a fast-growing vacation rental management company looking to add a Bookkeeping Admin to our team for the long term. As we scale, clean books are what keep our owners confident, our vendors reliable, and our business compliant. This role supports our financial back office: keeping expenses clean and categorized, validating and scheduling vendor payments, helping file occupancy taxes on time, and helping make sure owner statements are accurate before they go out. You also support supply ordering and other items the team and properties need. You support the bookkeeping before it reaches our accountant, so accuracy and follow-through matter here more than almost anywhere else in the company. This is a detail role for someone who has done this in short-term rentals before and understands owner statements, trust accounting, pass-through expenses, and occupancy tax.

Responsibilities

Review, code, and categorize all expenses and daily transactions, including reservation adjustments for discounts, altered stays, and refunds

Validate vendor payments before release, matching them to Breezeway work orders and approvals and confirming the work, amount, and rate are correct

Schedule and process vendor payments so nothing goes past due, and keep vendor records current

Prepare and file transient occupancy tax (TOT) returns and ready financial data for tax filings, keeping us compliant in every jurisdiction

Confirm the right occupancy tax rates and charge amounts are set across OTAs and direct bookings, and flag any gaps

Support the ordering of supplies and other items, tracking purchases against the right accounts

Support the owner statement review each cycle, checking for accuracy before statements go out

Reconcile all company and owner accounts in QBO and tie balances out to your PMS

Catch and resolve duplicate charges, missing receipts, and miscoded items, and keep clean documentation for every transaction

Support month-end close and the owner statement run

Results

Owner statements reviewed and ready by the 10th of each month

Owner-reported statement errors: 0 per cycle

Vendor payments past due or released with the wrong amount: 0 per month

TOT returns filed by their due date: 0 late filings

Uncategorized or unreconciled transactions at month-end close: 0

Requirements

Prior bookkeeping or AP experience inside vacation rental or short-term rental property management, non-negotiable

Experience with TopKey, or with expense tracking for a larger vacation rental management company

Hands-on QuickBooks Online (QBO) experience

Proficient in Google Workspace, including Sheets for data analysis and reporting

Experience in a short-term rental PMS, Streamline or Guesty required

Familiar with Breezeway work orders, and Notion for documentation

Experience preparing and filing TOT or lodging taxes, and familiar with how OTAs collect and remit occupancy tax

Understands owner statements, trust accounting, and the difference between owner-billable, company, and pass-through expenses

High attention to detail and able to self-check before anything leaves your desk

Organized and consistent with documentation

Comfortable building your own checklists and SOPs to work more efficiently and to guide others

What Success Looks Like in 90 Days

30 days: comfortable handling and categorizing all transactions, and paying some vendors

60 days: supporting owner statement reviews and understanding the TOT filing calendar

90 days: helping with month-end categorization and catching missing items, and ensuring owner statements are ready by the 10th



Hours: M-F 8-5 PST - 45 hours per week



Pay: $1,365 per month paid out on the 15th and 30th of the month

Wifi and VPN Stipend of $30 per month paid out as $15 on each paycheck



13th month awarded based on performance and hours worked throughout the year.

title: Part-Time IT & Security Engineer (Tier 2/3)
description:
Part-Time IT & Security Engineer (Tier 2/3)

Weekend Coverage + Optional Weekday Evenings | Remote, Philippines



Sentry is a US-based managed service provider (MSP) and physical security integrator serving small and mid-sized businesses across the New York metro area. On the IT side, we manage our clients' networks, servers, Microsoft 365 environments, endpoints, and phone systems. On the security side, we design, install, and support their video surveillance and access control systems.



We do things differently from most MSPs: we don't run a Tier 1 help desk. When a client reaches us, they get a skilled engineer who takes ownership immediately, not a scripted first-tier queue or an automated phone tree. That first-contact competence is a big part of why our clients enjoy working with us, and it's why we only hire technicians at Tier 2 and above.



We're hiring part-time to cover our weekends, Saturday and Sunday, and we have additional weekday evening shifts available for the right person. Weekends and evenings are much quieter than our weekday daytime operation, so this isn't a high-pressure call queue. You'll handle the calls,
s, and tickets that do come in, owning each from first contact through resolution, and spend the rest of your time moving project work forward: deployments, configurations, maintenance windows, documentation, and backlog cleanup. Weekends and evenings are also when we can safely take systems offline for upgrades that would disrupt clients during the day, so a meaningful part of this role is planned project execution, not just reactive support.



The weekend coverage is what we're most eager to fill. If you're interested, you can also pick up one or more weekday evening shifts on top of it; the full schedule is below.



Because you'll often be our main presence outside core business hours, independence and sound judgment matter here. You won't be alone: you'll have escalation paths to senior engineers and the owner, and we take on the hardest problems as a team, but you should be comfortable owning a client environment and knowing when to escalate. The role is fully remote, and you'll be a full member of our team, not an isolated, outsourced contractor.



What You'll Do



- Handle client requests by phone,
, and ticket during your shifts, and own them from first contact through resolution

- Deliver a confident, professional experience on every interaction; clients should feel they're in good hands from the first minute

- Execute project work handed off from the weekday team: deployments, migrations, network and system configuration, and backlog items that need uninterrupted time to complete

- Run maintenance windows: patching, firmware upgrades, server maintenance, and other changes best done while clients are offline

- Administer Microsoft 365 / Entra ID (Azure AD): user and license provisioning, Exchange Online, mail flow, and
 security

- Monitor and respond to RMM alerts (Atera) and manage endpoint security tools (Huntress, Bitdefender)

- Troubleshoot networks: firewalls (FortiGate), switches and access points (UniFi), VLANs, VPNs, and DNS

- Administer Windows Server, Active Directory, and Group Policy

- Manage and verify backups (Datto)

- Support VoIP systems and IP phones

- Configure, support, and troubleshoot video surveillance systems (IP cameras, NVRs, and video management software such as Hikvision, Digital Watchdog, and Speco), including secure remote access and viewing

- Administer access control systems (users, credentials, and door schedules) and troubleshoot controllers and readers

- Remotely support our field technicians during security-system installs and service calls

- Keep clear, accurate documentation for every client environment, including writing up the project work you complete

- Work alongside our AI tooling, which we use heavily across daily operations



What We're Looking For



- 3+ years of hands-on IT support experience, ideally at an MSP

- Excellent spoken and written English, with a strong customer-first attitude; you'll be the voice of our company on every call

- The confidence to own client interactions and project work independently, along with the judgment to know when to involve the team

- Self-direction: with lighter supervision outside business hours, you should be able to pick up a project, see it through, and document it without hand-holding

- Solid knowledge of Microsoft 365/Entra, Windows Server, Active Directory, and networking fundamentals

- Hands-on experience with firewalls and managed switches (FortiGate and UniFi a strong plus)

- Experience with IP video surveillance and/or access control systems, or the aptitude and willingness to develop this expertise quickly (it's a core part of what we do)

- Reliable high-speed internet with a backup connection

- A quiet, dedicated home workspace



Bonus Points



- Deep familiarity with AI tools, especially Claude, which we use extensively day to day

- Spanish-speaking ability (written and/or spoken)

- Hands-on experience with VMS platforms (e.g., DW Spectrum), access control systems, or remote video monitoring services (e.g., Immix)

- Certifications (CompTIA A+/Network+/Security+, Microsoft, Fortinet NSE, Ubiquiti, Cisco CCNA)

- PowerShell or other scripting



Work Setup



- 100% remote, based in the Philippines

- Part-time, permanent employee position, not contract work

- All hours are in US Eastern Time, which maps to an overnight or early-morning shift in the Philippines (about an hour later when the US is on standard time)



Weekend coverage, the core of this role (both days):

- Saturday, 10:00 AM to 10:00 PM ET (roughly 10:00 PM Sat to 10:00 AM Sun PHT)

- Sunday, 10:00 AM to 10:00 PM ET (roughly 10:00 PM Sun to 10:00 AM Mon PHT)

- About 24 hours per week



Optional weekday evening shifts, pick any one, two, or all three:

- Tuesday, 5:00 PM to 10:00 PM ET (roughly 5:00 AM to 10:00 AM Wed PHT)

- Thursday, 5:00 PM to 10:00 PM ET (roughly 5:00 AM to 10:00 AM Fri PHT)

- Friday, 5:00 PM to 10:00 PM ET (roughly 5:00 AM to 10:00 AM Sat PHT)

- 5 hours per shift



What We Offer



- Competitive USD pay, scaled to the shifts you take (same hourly-equivalent rate across all of them):

  - Weekend coverage (Saturday and Sunday): $1,200 to $1,500 per month, based on experience

  - Each weekday evening shift you add: approximately $250 to $315 per month per shift

  - For reference, taking all five shifts works out to roughly a full-time load at about $1,950 to $2,450 per month

- Paid time off, pro-rated for a part-time schedule

- A stable, long-term role with real room to grow, including the potential to expand into more hours

- A supportive, AI-forward team that invests in its people



How to Apply



To apply, send your resume and a short note about your MSP and IT experience, including any hands-on work with security systems and AI tools, and let us know which shifts you're available for: weekend coverage, weekday evenings, or both.

title: Revenue Manager, Sierra Sol Elevated Stays
description:
Sierra Sol Elevated Stays | Revenue Manager

Philippines – Direct Hire (Remote), aligned to U.S. hours



Sierra Sol Elevated Stays is a locally rooted, family-owned property management company serving New Mexico and Texas with 1,000+ vacation rental homes across multiple markets. Our love for these regions is what led us to build Sierra Sol Elevated Stays, focused on providing elevated stays for our guests and elevated stewardship for our homeowners. Our goal is to grow in a way that celebrates what makes our communities special, while delivering elevated experiences for guests and thoughtful, reliable stewardship for homeowners.



Our Elevated Promises

Everything we do is guided by our Elevated Promises. They are our operating standard and the way we earn five-star stays and trusted, long-term homeowner partnerships.



Elevated Guest Engagement: Proactive, elevated hospitality from booking to five-star review.

We believe vacations are special, something people save for, plan for, and look forward to. Our job is to make every stay feel seamless and memorable. We anticipate needs, communicate early, check in during the stay, and resolve issues quickly with warmth and care. Our guest journey is intentionally crafted to deliver the kind of responsiveness, thoughtfulness, and attention to detail that turns great trips into truly elevated experiences.



Elevated Home Stewardship: We care for every home as if it were our own.

As homeowners in our markets, we know what true home stewardship looks like. We operate with a proactive mindset of quality, consistency, and pride. Weekly home checks, rigorous cleaning standards, quality control, seasonal readiness, and preventive maintenance are all part of how we ensure every property is clean, protected, and presentation ready, for guests and for you. We treat every home with the same respect and diligence we expect for our own.



Elevated Homeowner Partnerships: We treat each home like our own investment.

Every homeowner has different goals, maximizing revenue, balancing personal use, focusing on long-term appreciation, or simply enjoying peace of mind. Our role is to be a true partner in those goals, not simply a property manager. As owners and operators in these regions ourselves, our guidance comes from real-world results, not theory. Through regular business reviews, thoughtful design and amenity recommendations, revenue and pricing insights, and brand-building support, we help each property reach its highest potential.



Revenue Management is one of the biggest ways we deliver these promises. This is business partnership work. You are a core part of our team, not an outsourced analyst function.



Job Description - Revenue Manager



Our Revenue Manager owns pricing, fee strategy, and performance analytics across 1,000+ vacation rental homes in New Mexico and Texas. You will maximize homeowner revenue and company profitability through disciplined pricing optimization, thoughtful fee architecture, and clear, data-driven storytelling to homeowners and internal leaders. You will build scalable reporting systems, lead owner business review preparation, and partner closely with Finance (reporting to our CFO), General Managers, Marketing, and Business Development to translate insights into action.



The Revenue Manager will own:

• Pricing strategy across all channels to maximize occupancy, ADR, RevPAR, and Net RevPAR

• Fee strategy to optimize company profitability while protecting guest conversion and homeowner satisfaction

• Owner quarterly and annual business reviews: templates, reporting, insights, and preparation support

• Quarterly market insights reporting by market, including context (weather, events, market shifts) and company and unit performance vs market benchmarks

• Rental Potential Analysis process and templates for prospective homeowners

• Amenity and upgrade ROI recommendations for current homeowners (incremental revenue projections and payback analysis)

• Growth analytics and new homeowner identification using tools like AirDNA, Wheelhouse, Audiences, and our CRM, including lead scoring and data enrichment



Working Hours

This role is full-time and will primarily align to U.S. business hours, expect 4-6 hours overlap with U.S. Central Time zone.

• Core hours: Monday to Friday during U.S. hours with flexibility based on business needs

• Weekly revenue standups and market reviews (standing cadence)

• Light weekend monitoring during peak periods as needed for pacing shifts, promotions, and exception management



Compensation and Incentives

• Base pay: $1,800–$2,300 USD per month (full-time, based on experience, STR revenue expertise, and ability to lead multi-market strategy)

• 13th month pay: Provided in December (prorated for partial years)

• Performance Bonus: Quarterly performance bonus target of 15–20% of base pay (annualized), tied to a scorecard

• PTO: Accrues at 1.25 paid days per month (usable after 90 days; no annual rollover)



Location

This role is fully remote within the Philippines.



Role and Responsibilities



Champion the Elevated Promises:

• Lead with an owner-partner mindset, ensuring our recommendations balance homeowner goals, guest conversion, and long-term performance

• Communicate insights with clarity and warmth, especially when market conditions are challenging

• Hold a high bar for data accuracy and defensible assumptions in all owner-facing reporting



Revenue Management and Pricing Strategy

• Own portfolio pricing strategy across channels, including rate plans, minimum stay rules, last-minute strategy, and length-of-stay controls

• Maintain pricing guardrails by market, season, and property type (floors, ceilings, event premiums, and exception rules)

• Monitor pacing daily and weekly, identify anomalies early, and recommend corrective actions

• Partner with GMs and Guest Experience leadership to align pricing with operational realities and guest experience considerations



Fee Strategy and Profitability Optimization

• Design and refine guest-facing and owner-facing fee structures with clear guardrails and internal governance

• Assess fee elasticity and conversion impact, and recommend adjustments based on performance data

• Collaborate with Finance to ensure fee models and reporting definitions are consistent across markets and statements



Owner Business Reviews (QBR/ABR) and Reporting

• Own Quarterly & Annual Business Review templates and associated regular updates

• Segment owners (top performers, at-risk, new homes, premium homes) and tailor insights accordingly

• Prepare performance narratives: what happened, why it happened, what we did, and what we will do next quarter

• Build owner retention risk indicators and trigger internal workflows when performance and sentiment signals indicate risk



Market Insights and Benchmarking

• Produce quarterly market insights reports by market, including seasonality, demand drivers, weather impacts, and competitive dynamics

• Benchmark performance against market data and comp sets where available, and translate into clear, owner-friendly insights

• Maintain a market events calendar and seasonal assumptions library to support consistent forecasting and storytelling



Growth Enablement

• Develop and maintain Rental Potential Analysis tools and assumptions (conservative, base, and upside cases)

• Partner with Business Development and Marketing to create compelling, data-driven sales enablement content

• Lead new homeowner identification by utilizing tools to identify new homeowner leads, building target lists, scoring leads, and loading actionable opportunities into the CRM

• Optionally support initial outreach sequences 
 or text) if structured as part of the role



Amenity and Upgrade ROI Recommendations

• Build an amenity uplift and ROI library by market and property type (e.g., hot tubs, EV chargers, game rooms)

• Provide clear owner recommendations with projected revenue lift, payback period, and considerations for ongoing maintenance and guest experience

• Create upgrade packages and playbooks to help owners d
 faster and align improvements to guest expectations



Tools, Systems, and Operating Rhythm

• Become an expert user and functional owner of tools like Wheelhouse, AirDNA, Audiences, and our CRM

• Build dashboards and weekly reporting for portfolio health (occupancy, ADR, RevPAR, Net RevPAR, margin, lead time, cancellations)

• Establish a structured experimentation approach for fee changes, discount ladders, minimum stay rules, and channel strategies

• Run a weekly cadence with Finance and operations leaders to review pacing, underperformers, and action plans



Revenue Manager Success Measures

• Portfolio and market performance improves across occupancy, ADR, RevPAR, and Net RevPAR relative to baseline

• Fee strategy increases company profitability without meaningfully reducing conversion or owner satisfaction

• QBRs and ABRs are delivered on time with clear insights and consistent data accuracy

• Underperforming homes are identified quickly and translated into actionable plans with internal owners

• Market insights reporting builds trust and reduces owner friction during challenging demand periods

• Rental Potential Analyses support growth conversion and help fill the top of the homeowner funnel



Qualifications

• 3+ years experience in revenue management for short-term rentals

• Experience managing revenue for 200+ units and/or multi-market portfolios

• Experience running experimentation (discount ladders, minimum stay changes, fee tests) with documented outcomes

• Experience using pricing and market data tools (Wheelhouse, PriceLabs, Beyond, AirDNA, etc.)

• Advanced Excel/Google Sheets skills (modeling, scenario analysis, clean reporting)

• Strong written communication and ability to translate data into clear owner-friendly insights



How to apply

Please submit the following:

• Resume/CV

• Short written note: Why Sierra Sol Elevated Stays, and why this role

• One work sample (or short write-up): A market or portfolio performance insight you have delivered and the actions you recommended

• Provide a 1–2 page write-up (or slides) addressing the following:

Market: Angel Fire, New Mexico

Problem: pacing is down YoY due to lack of snowfall and spring break is coming up in March

description:

s pile up, my scheduling's a mess, and stuff slips because I'm the only one touching it. I need someone to take that whole layer off my plate.



The dream hire here is pretty simple: I wake up, and you've already gone through my inbox, lined up my day, and put a short list in front of me of what matters most. I stop being the guy managing every little thing, and you become the person who keeps it all moving.



Here's the kind of stuff you'd be handling:



- My inbox. Reading it, sorting it, knocking out the easy replies, and only pulling me in when something needs me specifically.

About the Role We're hiring a hands-on Financial Planning & Analysis Analyst to own the day-to-day financial visibility of our telemedicine business. Responsibilities

- Build leadership dashboards covering KPIs, cohort views, and channel performance

- Lead pricing analysis, promo and discount ROI, and vendor and SaaS spend reviews

- Deliver budget vs. actuals reporting with variance commentary

- Monitor cash flow and runway, and support month-end close alongside accounting

- Partner with marketing, ops, and clinical teams on ad-hoc deep dives, including churn and retention analysis



What We're Looking For



- 3+ years in FP&A, finance, or analytics, ideally at a DTC, telehealth, or subscription company

- Deep experience with LTV/CAC modeling and ad performance analysis

- Comfortable in the weeds with daily data while keeping sight of the strategic picture

- Excel/Sheets fluency; BI tools (Looker, Tableau, Metabase) a plus

title: Full-Time AI Content Creator (Image + Video)
description:
Full-Time AI Content Creator (Image + Video) 



About the Role



We are a private content agency that builds and operates AI-generated personas for social media (Instagram, X/Twitter) and subscription platforms. We are hiring a full-time AI Content Creator to produce high-quality AI image and video content with strong character consistency. This is a pure content-creation role — no posting, no community management, and no DM handling. You create the assets; another team publishes them. You will receive a complete SOP and a reference library, so your targets and quality standard are clear from day one.



Please note: this role includes creating mature, adult-oriented content for an AI persona. You must be 18+ and fully comfortable working with adult themes. Full content details are covered during the interview. If that is not a fit for you, please do not apply.



What You Will Do



Generate AI images and videos of our personas that stay perfectly consistent (face, body, and style) across every asset.

Produce content following the provided brand and reference guidelines.



Edit, retouch, upscale, and clean up generations to a publish-ready standard.



Follow our metadata and content-sanitizing process before delivery.



Organize finished work in the correct folder structure and submit a short daily report at the end of each shift.



Required Skills and Tools (Must Have)



Hands-on experience with AI image generation: Nano Banana, GPT Image 2, Seedream 4.5, Flux, etc..



ComfyUI with Stable Diffusion, including LoRA training for character consistency is an asset.



Face swap, inpainting, and upscaling.



AI video generation: Wan and/or Kling.



CapCut Pro (advanced editing) — must have.



Strong eye for realism, anatomy, lighting, and detail; able to spot and fix AI artifacts.



Strong Plus (Nice to Have)



Hailuo / MiniMax with Seedance 2.0.

Experience producing content for AI influencer / subscription-platform personas.

Comfortable working primarily on Wavespeed (our main daily platform — tokens provided).



Equipment Requirements



A reliable computer with an NVIDIA GPU, minimum RTX 3060 12GB or RTX 4060 Ti 16GB or Silicon chip Mac is a big asset.

Stable high-speed internet (a live speed test will be done during the interview).



Schedule and Commitment



Full-time: 40 to 50 hours per week.

100% remote and async, flexible schedule.

Our team operates on U.S. Pacific Time — your hours should overlap reasonably and be consistent.

A short end-of-shift daily report is required.



Compensation



$3 to $5 per hour (USD) to start, depending on experience, with performance-based raises.

First month is a paid trial, paid weekly. After the trial, payment moves to monthly.



Portfolio (Required with Your Application)



Send a portfolio that demonstrates character consistency across a set of the SAME AI persona — same face, same body, same style across multiple images and at least one short video. Work that mixes different faces/models will not be considered, because consistency is the core of this role. Full portfolio requirements are shared once you reply.



How to Apply

Reply here on OnlineJobs.ph with the following:



Start your message with the word BIKINI (this confirms you read the full post).

A link to your resume.

A link to your portfolio.

A short note on your AI tool stack and your GPU setup.
